data.name: A Friend in Need
data.description: You freed the captive forest fury from the Corym Black Market. A friend in need is a friend indeed!
data.spoiler: Help A Captive Forest Fury to escape during the Threatened Dreams - Sweet Dreams Quest.

data.name: A reliable Friend
data.description: The hungry ram devoured the whole bunch of turnips in a single bite, then looked at you as if it was ready for more. Make sure to keep it well fed along the way.
data.spoiler: Tame a Reliable Ram.

data.name: A Study in Scarlett
data.description: You ended the regn of Scarlett Etzel. All-seeing yet blind, ever powerful yet ultimately helpless, she never got a second chance to truly see. Or has she...
data.spoiler: Defeat Scarlett Etzel in the Grave Danger Quest.

data.name: A Well-Honed Arsenal
data.description: Your expertise in weaponry reaches new heights.
data.spoiler: Reach the Mastery Weapon Proficiency level on 10 weapons.

data.name: Afraid of no Ghost!
data.description: You passed their test and helped the Spirithunters testing equipment, researching the supernatural and catching ghosts - it's you they're gonna call.
data.spoiler: Complete the Spirithunters Quest.

data.name: All Hail the King
data.description: Old temples, a meadowy countryside and the splendour of Thais - you really know every corner of King Tibianus' realm now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Thais in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Allow Cookies?
data.description: With a perfectly harmless smile you fooled all of those wisecrackers into eating your exploding cookies. Consider a boy or girl scout outfit next time to make the trick even better.
data.spoiler: Complete mission 10 of What a Foolish Quest.

data.name: Allowance Collector
data.description: You certainly have your ways when it comes to acquiring money. Many of them are pink and paved with broken fragments of porcelain.
data.spoiler: Break 50 Piggy Banks.

data.name: Alpha Rider
data.description: You never can tell, who's boss here.
data.spoiler: Get the Alpha Demonosaur mount by using a Demon in a Golden Box.

data.name: Alumni
data.description: You're considered a first-rate graduate of the Magic Academy in Edron due to your pioneering discoveries and successful studies in the field of experimental magic and spell development. Ever considered teaching the Armageddon spell?
data.spoiler: Complete the female Summoner Outfit or the male Mage Outfit.

data.name: Amateur Actor
data.description: You helped bringing Princess Buttercup, Doctor Dumbness and Lucky the Wonder Dog to life - and will probably dream of them tonight, since you memorised your lines perfectly. What a .. special piece of.. screenplay.
data.spoiler: Complete mission 4 of The Thieves Guild Quest.

data.name: Amati's Echo
data.description: You answered the call of the moon goddess and thwarted the asuri's plans. Yet the echoes will linger, and the whisper of the moonsilver is now a part of Marapur.
data.spoiler: Complete the Shards of a Broken Moon Quest.

data.name: Ancient Splendor
data.description: You've braved the perils of Yalahar and learned of its gloomy shadows of long gone greatness.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Yalahar in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Animal Activist
data.description: You have a soft spot for little, weak animals, and you do everything in your power to protect them - even if you probably eat dragons for breakfast.
data.spoiler:
Complete mission 3 of The Ice Islands Quest and The Tortoise Mission from Duncan in Meriana Quest.

Note: If you completed the steps and didn't get the achievement, kill a few Huskies in Svargrond and pay your fine to Iskan.

data.name: Annihilator
data.description: You've daringly jumped into the infamous Annihilator and survived - taking home fame, glory and your reward.
data.spoiler: Finish The Annihilator Quest.

data.name: Arachnoise
data.description: You've shattered each of Bloodweb's eight frozen legs. As they say: break a leg, and then some more.
data.spoiler: Slay Bloodweb.

data.name: Archpostman
data.description: Delivering letters and parcels has always been a secret passion of yours, and now you can officially put on your blue hat, blow your Post Horn and do what you like to do most. Beware of dogs!
data.spoiler: Complete The Postman Quest.

data.name: Areas of Effect
data.description: Wisely contributing your resources to areas, you pushed creatures to maximum effect, allowing improved respawn for everyone! Well done!
data.spoiler: Donate a total of 1 million gold to improve the respawn of any area in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Aristocrat
data.description: You begin your day by bathing in your pot of gold and you don't mind showing off your wealth while strolling the streets in your best clothes - after all it's your hard-earned money! You prefer to be addressed with 'Your Highness'.
data.spoiler: Complete the Nobleman Outfit.

data.name: Arsenal of War
data.description: Feared by your enemies, admired by many - your reputation in weapon mastery precedes you.
data.spoiler: Reach the Mastery Weapon Proficiency level on 50 weapons.

data.name: Ashes to Dust
data.description: Staking vampires and demons has almost turned into your profession. You make sure to gather even the tiniest amount of evil dust particles. Beware of silicosis.
data.spoiler: Use a blessed wooden stake 500 times successfully.

data.name: Askarak Nemesis
data.description: You are now the royal archfiend of the Askarak, prince slayer.
data.spoiler: Kill 100 Askarak Prince.

data.name: Avid Spectral Reader
data.description: What draws things to other dimensions, one wonders. You read the almanac at just the right spot to end up... where, of all places? That is the problem with dimensional travel: you will never know. Or you have always known. And everything in between.
data.spoiler: Use The Spatial Warp Almanac inside Gaffir's secret room in the Cobra Bastion.

data.name: Aye-aye, Captain!
data.description: Being the captain is as much a privilege to some as it is a burden to others. You took the helm by doing everything to make the Great Expedition succeed. Steer clear of trouble, stay your course and a bright future will always be ahead of you!

data.name: Baby Sitter
data.description: You have cheered up a demon baby and returned it to its mother. A quick count of your fingers will reveal if you made it through unharmed.
data.spoiler: Return a pleased Demon Infant to Demon Mother during the Demon's Lullaby event.

data.name: Back from the Dead
data.description: You overcame the undead Zanakeph and sent him back into the darkness that spawned him.
data.spoiler: Slay Zanakeph.

data.name: Back into the Abyss
data.description: You've cut off a whole lot of tentacles today. Thul was driven back to where he belongs.
data.spoiler: Slay Thul.

data.name: Backpack Tourist
data.description: If someone lost a random thing in a random place, you're probably a good person to ask and go find it, even if you don't know what and where.
data.spoiler: Give back the Old and Used Backpack to Sam.

data.name: Bad Timing
data.description: Argh! Not now! How is it that those multifunctional tools never fail when you're using them for something completely trivial like squeezing juice, but mess up when you desperately need to climb up a rope spot with a fire-breathing dragon chasing you?
data.spoiler: Jam a Secret Agent Tool 10 times.

data.name: Bane of the Hive
data.description: Countless fights and never tiring effort in the war against the hive grant you the experience to finish your outfit with the last remaining part. Your chitin outfit is a testament of your skills and dedication for the cause.
data.spoiler: Complete the Insectoid Outfit.

data.name: Banebringers' Bane
data.description: You sacrificed a lot of ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches and played a significant part in the efforts to repel the dreaded banebringers. The drawback is that even the banebringers may take notice of you ...
data.spoiler: Throw 50 ingredients into the witches cauldron during the Bewitched event.

data.name: Bastard
data.description: You freed the remnants of the Order of the Stag on the Isle of Ada from a warlock's yoke. An evil puppet master who lead many Stags against their own brethren. Eldoran the Ambitious, heir of Eldoran Etzel, Cadwgan's bastard son, is forever grateful.
data.spoiler: Complete The Order of the Stag Quest.

data.name: Bat Person
data.description: No matter your command, this beast is all ears!
data.spoiler: Complete the Bloody Tusks Quest.

data.name: Battle Mage
data.description: Wielding dangerous knowledge as well as the sword is your expertise. You have proven yourself versatile in all manner of situations.
data.spoiler: Get the Battle Mage Outfit.

data.name: Beach Tamer
data.description: You re-enacted the Taming of the Shrew on a beach setting and proved that you can handle capricious girls quite well. With or without fish tails.
data.spoiler: Complete The Mermaid Marina Quest.

data.name: Beak Doctor
data.description: You significantly helped the afflicted citizens of Venore in times of dire need. Somehow you still feel close to the victims of the fever outbreak. Your clothes make you one of them, one poor soul amongst the countless afflicted.
data.spoiler: Complete the Afflicted Outfit.

data.name: Bearbaiting
data.description: Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
data.spoiler: Tame a Bear.

data.name: Bearhugger
data.description: Warm, furry and cuddly - though that same bear you just hugged would probably rip you into pieces if he had been conscious, he reminded you of that old teddy bear which always slept in your bed when you were still small.
data.spoiler: Complete mission 2 of Barbarian Test.

data.name: Beautiful Agony
data.description: Ethershrek's cry of agony kept ringing in your ear for hours after he had dissolved into thin air. He probably moved to another plane of existence... for a while.
data.spoiler: Slay Ethershreck.

data.name: Beaver Away
data.description: You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!
data.spoiler: Tame a Giant Beaver.

data.name: Becoming a Bigfoot
data.description: You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
data.spoiler: Complete the Recruitment mission of Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Beneath the Sea
data.description: Not really twenty thousand miles, but you had to dive a fair way beneath the sea to find your personal Manta Ray.
data.spoiler: Tame a Manta Ray.

data.name: Berry Picker
data.description: The Combined Magical Winterberry Society hereby honours continued selfless dedication and extraordinary efforts in the Annual Autumn Vintage.
data.spoiler: Paticipate 3 years in the Annual Autumn Vintage event.

data.name: Berserker
data.description: RAWR! Strength running through your body, your heart racing faster and adrenaline fueling your every weapon swing. All in a little bottle. No refund for destroyed furniture. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
data.spoiler: Drink 100 Berserk Potions.

data.name: Bewitcher
data.description: You literally put everything in that cauldron except lilac and gooseberries.
data.spoiler: Get 750 favour points in the Bewitched event.

data.name: Beyonder
data.description: Adventurous beyond death, you travelled the Netherworld. Although you had just the ghost of a chance you survived and even came back from the realm of the dead.
data.spoiler: Finish the Feaster of Souls Quest.

data.name: Bibby's Bloodbath
data.description: You lend a helping hand in defeating invading Orcs by destroying their warcamp along with their leader. Bibby's personal bloodbath...
data.spoiler: Kill Bibby Bloodbath.

data.name: Bibliomaniac
data.description: You passion for reading was somewhat diminished by biting books and aggressive quills. But this flying specimen proved to be a loyal companion. Never judge a book by its cover!
data.spoiler: Tame a Flying Book.

data.name: Biodegradable
data.description: You caught fifty rare shimmer swimmers. Getting rid of all those corpses by dumping them into the lake really was worth it, wasn't it? Wait, didn't something move in the water just now...?
data.spoiler: Fish 50 Shimmer Swimmers.

data.name: Blacknailed
data.description: Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
data.spoiler: Tame a Gravedigger.

data.name: Blessed!
data.description: You travelled the world for an almost meaningless prayer - but at least you don't have to do that again and can get a new blessed stake in the blink of an eye.
data.spoiler: Finish The Blessed Stake Quest.

data.name: Blood-Red Snapper
data.description: You've tainted the jungle floor with the Snapper's crimson blood.
data.spoiler: Slay The Snapper.

data.name: Bluebarian
data.description: You live the life of hunters and gatherers. Well, especially that of a gatherer, and especially of one who gathers lots of blueberries. Have you checked the colour of your tongue lately?
data.spoiler: Use Blueberry Bushes 500 times.

data.name: Bone Brother
data.description: You've joined the undead bone brothers - making death your enemy and your weapon as well. Devouring what's weak and leaving space for what's strong is your primary goal.
data.spoiler: Join the Brotherhood of Bones in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest.

data.name: Bounacean Chivalry
data.description: Yselda forever stands watch against the carnisylvan menace. Ever awake, waiting in the dark, her heart longs to be united with her king once again. Deep empathy let a hero to bring her Kesar's tulip as a token of his love. That hero was you.
data.spoiler: Use the Violet Tulip (from the Adventures of Galthen Quest) next to Yselda.

data.name: Breaking the Ice
data.description: You almost made friends with Shardhead... before he died. Poor guy only seems to attract violence with his frosty attitude.
data.spoiler: Slay Shardhead.

data.name: Brutal Politeness
data.description: What is best in life? To crush your enemies. To see them driven before you. And to maybe have a nice cup of tea afterwards.
data.spoiler: Complete the Barbarian Outfit.

data.name: Bunny Slipped
data.description: Indeed, you have a soft spot for rabbits. Maybe the rabbits you saved today will be the rabbits that will save you tomorrow. When you are really hungry.
data.spoiler: Give 7 fake rabbit's feet to Rottin Wood.

data.name: Buried the Baron
data.description: You defeated the Baron from Below and destroyed his lava pump!
data.spoiler: Defeat The Baron From Below in the Dangerous Depths Quest.

data.name: Cake Conqueror
data.description: You have bravely stepped onto the cake isle. Is there any more beautiful, tasty place to be in the whole world?
data.spoiler: Step on a spot where cake was already eaten during A Piece of Cake event.

data.name: Call Me Sparky
data.description: Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
data.spoiler: Complete the Raiders of the Lost Spark task of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Cartography 101
data.description: You succeeded in finding and charting several previously unexplored landmarks and locations for the Adventurer's Guild, you probably never need to ask anyone for the way - do you?
data.spoiler: Finish the Cartography 101 Quest.

data.name: Castle Crasher
data.description: Somebody will be terribly sad about your actions! Imagine how much time it took to build all those castles ....
data.spoiler: Step on 10 Sand Castles around Aragonia.

data.name: Castlemania
data.description: You have an eye for suspicious places and love to read other people's diaries, especially those with vampire stories in it. You're also a dedicated token collector and explorer. Respect!
data.spoiler: Finish the Blood Brothers Quest, mark all 8 spots on Julius' Map, finish the Vampire Hunter Quest, pick up the Blood Skull and Blood Goblet, and turn in all missing diary pages.

data.name: Cave Completionist
data.description: Cave Completionist
data.spoiler: Complete the Cave Explorer Outfit.

data.name: Champion of Chazorai
data.description: You won the merciless 2 vs. 2 team tournament on the Isle of Strife and wiped out wave after wave of fearsome opponents. Death or victory - you certainly chose the latter.
data.spoiler: Complete mission 9 of The New Frontier Quest.

data.name: Champion of Summer
data.description: You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Summer Court.
data.spoiler: Join the Summer Dreamelves and kill 20 bosses at the Dream Scar during the Dream Courts Quest.

data.name: Champion of Winter
data.description: You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Winter Court.
data.spoiler: Join the Winter Dreamelves and kill 20 bosses at the Dream Scar during the Dream Courts Quest.

data.name: Chequered Teddy
data.description: Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
data.spoiler: Tame a Panda.

data.name: Chest Robber
data.description: You've discovered three nomad camps and stole their supplies. Well, you can probably use them better then they can.
data.spoiler: Open all 3 chests from Nomad camps during the Nomads Mini World Change.

data.name: Chitin Bane
data.description: You have become competent and efficient in gathering the substance that is needed to fight the hive. You almost smell like dissolved chitin and the Hive Born would tell their children scary stories about you if they could speak.
data.spoiler: Repeat Dissolved Chitin task 100 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Choking on Her Venom
data.description: the Old Widow fell prey to your supreme hunting skills.
data.spoiler: Slay The Old Widow.

data.name: Chorister
data.description: Lalalala... you now know the cult's hymn sung in Liberty Bay by heart. Not that hard, considering that it mainly consists of two notes and repetitive lyrics.
data.spoiler: Learn all 4 Music Sheets.

data.name: Citizen of Issavi
data.description: It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
data.spoiler: Get the full Citizen of Issavi Outfit.

data.name: Clay Fighter
data.description: You love getting your hands wet and dirty - and covered with clay. Your perfect sculpture of Brog, the raging Titan is your true masterpiece.
data.spoiler: Make a Pretty Clay Statue from a Clay Lump.

data.name: Clay to Fame
data.description: Sculpting Brog, the raging Titan, is your secret passion. Numerous perfect little clay statues with your name on them can be found everywhere around Tibia.
data.spoiler: Make five Pretty Clay Statues from Clay Lumps.

data.name: Cobbled and Patched
data.description: Exploring the depths of Tibia can be a dangerous task. Surprisingly, some crude wood planks, rusty nails and a tinged pot can offer a sufficient protection against the creatures lurking in the deep.
data.spoiler: Complete the Makeshift Warrior Outfit.

data.name: Cocoon of Doom
data.description: You helped bringing Devovorga's dangerous tentacles and her humongous cocoon down - not stopping her transformation, but ultimately completing a crucial step to her death.
data.spoiler: Do sufficiently damage to a Bloom of Doom during the last minute of the fight during the Rise of Devovorga event.

data.name: Cold as Ice
data.description: Take an ice cube and an obsidian knife and you'll very likely shape something really pretty from it. Mostly cute little mammoths, which are a hit with all the girls.
data.spoiler: Sculpt 10 Ice Mammoths from Ice Cubes.

data.name: Combo Master
data.description: You accomplished 10 or more consecutive chains in a row! That's killing at least 39 creatures in the correct order - now that's combinatorics!
data.spoiler: Finish at least 10 consecutive Combinatorics tasks perfectly in the Oramond Quest.

data.name: Commitment Phobic
data.description: Longterm relationships are just not for you. And each time you think you're in love, you're proven wrong shortly afterwards. Or maybe you just end up with the wrong lover each time - exploited and betrayed. Staying single might just be better.
data.spoiler: Divorce 3 times.

data.name: Confusion
data.description: The destruction you have caused by now can be felt throughout the whole hive. The mayhem that follows your step caused significant confusion in the consciousness of the hive.
data.spoiler: Repeat Destroy The Hive Crystals task 50 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Contender
data.description: You have fully unlocked 10 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
data.spoiler: Unlock all details from 10 medium monsters in your Bestiary.

data.name: Cookie Monster
data.description: You can easily be found by anyone if they just follow the cookie crumb trail. And for you, true love means to give away your last cookie.
data.spoiler: Bake Cookies 20 times.

data.name: Corruption Contained
data.description: You have managed to stall the worst incursion of corruption. Still this is just one battle won in an all out war for your world.
data.spoiler: Finish the Cults of Tibia Quest.

data.name: Crawling Death
data.description: You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
data.spoiler: Slay Fleshcrawler.

data.name: Crystal Clear
data.description: If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you had probably changed your underwear in time.
data.spoiler: Complete the Crystal Warlord Outfit.

data.name: Crystal Keeper
data.description: So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
data.spoiler: Complete the Crystal Keeper task of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Crystals in Love
data.description: You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. To bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
data.spoiler: Complete the Matchmaker task of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Culinary Master
data.description: Simple hams and bread merely make you laugh. You're the master of the extra-ordinaire, melter of cheese, fryer of bat wings and shaker of shakes. Delicious!
data.spoiler: Cook all the dishes in the Hot Cuisine Quest twice.

data.name: Cursed!
data.description: The wrath of the Noxious Spawn - you accidentally managed to incur it. Your days are counted and your death inevitable. Sometime. Someplace.
data.spoiler: Get cursed by the Claw of 'The Noxious Spawn'.

data.name: Daraman's Footsteps
data.description: You journeyed through Darashia and the sea of sand around it, while fighting the perils of the desert
data.spoiler: Fully discover Darashia in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Daring Trespasser
data.description: You've entered the lair of Devovorga and joined the crew trying to take her down - whether crowned with success or not doesn't matter, but they can't blame you for not trying!
data.spoiler: Enter Devovorga's lair on Vengoth during the Rise of Devovorga Quest.

data.name: Dark Voodoo Priest
data.description: Sinister curses, evil magic - you don't shy away from punishing others by questionable means. Someone just gave you a strange look - now where's that needle again?
data.spoiler: Use dworc Voodoo Doll on someone till bloodhit.

data.name: Dazzler
data.description: In the war against the hive, your efforts in blinding it begin to pay off. Your actions have blinded the hive severely and the entity seems to become aware that something dangerous is happening.
data.spoiler: Repeat Antenna Blinding task 50 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Death from Below
data.description: The face of the enemy is unmasked. You have encountered one of 'those below' and survived. More then that, you mananged to kill the beast and prove once and for all that the enemy can be beaten.
data.spoiler: Open the treasure chest of Abyssador for the first time after slaying it.

data.name: Death in the Depths
data.description: The Baron from Below, Duke of the Depths and the Count of the Core are no more!
data.spoiler: Kill the boss from Warzone 4, 5 and 6.

data.name: Death on Strike
data.description: Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
data.spoiler: Open Deathstrike's chest 50 times.

data.name: Death Song
data.description: You hushed the songs of war in the black depths by sliencing more than three hundred Deepling Spellsingers.
data.spoiler: Kill 300 Deepling Spellsingers.

data.name: Deep Sea Diver
data.description: Under the sea - might not be your natural living space, but you're feeling quite comfortable on the ocean floor. Quara don't scare you anymore and sometimes you sleep with your helmet of the deep still equipped.
data.spoiler: Walk 1,000,000 steps underwater.

data.name: Deer Hunt
data.description: You managed to kill more than four hundred white deer - it looks like you are one of the main reasons they will soon be considered extinct, way to go!
data.spoiler: Kill 400 Enraged White Deer or Desperate White Deer.

data.name: Demonbane
data.description: You don't carry that stake just for decoration - you're prepared to use it. Usually you're seen hightailing through the deepest dungeons leaving a trail of slain demons. Whoever dares stand in your way should prepare to die.
data.spoiler: Complete the Demon Hunter Outfit.

data.name: Demonic Barkeeper
data.description: Thick, red - shaken, not stirred - and with a straw in it: that's the way you prefer your demon blood. Served with an onion ring, the subtle metallic aftertaste is almost not noticeable. Beneficial effects on health or mana are welcome.
data.spoiler: Shake 250 Concentrated Demonic Blood.

data.name: Depth Dwellers
data.description: By eliminating at least three hundred Deepling Warriors you delivered quite a blow to the amassing armies of the deep.
data.spoiler: Kill 300 Deepling Warriors.

data.name: Desert Fisher
data.description: You managed to catch a fish in a surrounding that usually doesn't even carry water. Everything is subject to change, probably...
data.spoiler: Fish a Sandfish during River Runs Deep Mini World Change.

data.name: Devovorga's Nemesis
data.description: One special hero among many. This year - it was you. Devovorga withdrew in a darker realm because she could not withstand your power - and that of your comrades. Time will tell if the choice you made was good - but for now, it saved your world.
data.spoiler: Contribute significantly to the battle with Devovorga during the Rise of Devovorga World Quest.

data.name: Diplomatic Immunity
data.description: You killed the ambassador of the abyss that often that they might consider sending another one. Perhaps that will one day stop further intrusions.
data.spoiler: Open Abyssador's chest 50 times.

data.name: Do A Barrel Roll!
data.description: Riding a traditional beer barrel from the Orcsoberfest is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Beer sold separately.
data.spoiler: Tame a Rolling Barrel.

data.name: Do Not Disturb
data.description: Urgh! Close the windows! Shut out the sun rearing its ugly yellow head, shut out the earsplitting laughter of your neighbour's corpulent children. Ahhh. Embrace sweet darkness and silence.
data.spoiler: Close house windows 100 times.

data.name: Doctor! Doctor!
data.description: Did someone call a doctor? You delivered 100 medicine bags to Ottokar of the Venore poor house in times of dire need, well done!
data.spoiler: Deliver 100 Medicine Pouches to Ottokar in Venore Poor House.

data.name: Dog Sitter
data.description: You showed Noodles the way home. How long will it take this time until he's on the loose again? That dog must be really bored in the throne room by now.
data.spoiler: Find the King's dog Noodles during the Noodles is Gone Mini World Change.

data.name: Down the Drain
data.description: You've found a secret dungeon in the flooded plains and killed several of its inhabitants. And now you have wet feet.
data.spoiler: Kill 50 water elementals in the Water Elemental Dungeon during Down the Drain Mini World Change.

data.name: Dragon Mimicry
data.description: It's not really a dragon, but rather a kind of chimera. Nonetheless a decent mount to impress any passer-by.
data.spoiler: Tame a Dragonling.

data.name: Drama in Darama
data.description: If a pride of lions and a pack of hyaenas feud, it is not called a catfight but a ... whatsoever. For sure, it caused a lot of drama in the Darama Desert.
data.spoiler: Finish An Ancient Feud in the Grimvale Quest.

data.name: Dread Lord
data.description: You don't care for rules that others set up and shape the world to your liking. Having left behind meaningless conventions and morals, you prize only the power you wield. You're a master of your fate and battle to cleanse the world.
data.spoiler: Get the rank of Dread Lord of the Brotherhood of Bones faction in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest.

data.name: Dream Catcher
data.description: You are the slayer of the ancient nightmare beast and prevented the nightmare to spread its madness.
data.spoiler: Kill The Nightmare Beast in The Dream Courts Quest.

data.name: Dream Warden
data.description: It doesn't matter what noise you would hear... dream, nightmare, illusion - there is nothing you can't vanquish. You are a true Dream Warden.
data.spoiler: Complete the Dream Warden Outfit.

data.name: Dream Warrior
data.description: You became an acquaintance of the courts of dreams and acquired the right to display your new status and title of 'dream warrior'.
data.spoiler: Complete the Dream Warrior Outfit.

data.name: Dream Wright
data.description: You have mended many a broken dream and so, the dream of Roshamuul is safely being told over and over again.
data.spoiler: Repeat the Mend What's Broken task 34 times in the Roshamuul Quest.

data.name: Dream's Over
data.description: No more fear and bad dreams. You stabbed Tormentor to death with its scythe leg.
data.spoiler: Slay Tormentor.

data.name: Duked It Out
data.description: You defeated the Duke of the Depths and destroyed his lava pump!
data.spoiler: Defeat The Duke Of The Depths in the Dangerous Depths Quest.

data.name: Dungeon Cleaner
data.description: Seen it all. Done it all. Your unstoppable force swept through the dungeons and you vanquished their masters. Not to forget the precious loot you took! Now stop reading this and continue hunting! Time is money after all!
data.spoiler: Clear all 3 Warzones.

data.name: Dwarven Mines
data.description: Vast mines, an orc fortress and the magnificence of Kazordoon - you really know every corner of North-Eastern Mainland now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Kazordoon in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Echo Conqueror
data.description: Exploring the echoes was only the beginning. Now, you conquer them.
data.spoiler: Kill 100 Echo Wardens. Repeated kills from the same Echo Warden also counts.

data.name: Echo Hunter
data.description: The echoes are beginning to infiltrate your dreams.
data.spoiler: Step on an Echo Raid 50 times.

data.name: Echo Initiate
data.description: You are quite curious about these echoes.
data.spoiler: Step on an Echo raid for the first time.

data.name: Echo Walker
data.description: Walking past an echo is no option. You're already addicted.
data.spoiler: Step on an Echo Raid 500 times.

data.name: Efreet Ally
data.description: Even though the Efreet welcomed you only reluctantly and viewed you as "only a human" for quite some time, you managed to impress Malor and gained his respect and trade options with the green djinns.
data.spoiler: Finish The Djinn War - Efreet Faction.

data.name: Elementary, My Dear
data.description: Through the spirit of science and exploration, you have discovered how to enter the secret hideout of the renowned Dr Merlay.
data.spoiler: Drink a Pint of Glooth and access Dr Merlay's hideout during Dr Merlay's Misery Task in the Oramond Quest.

data.name: Elite Hunter
data.description: You jump at every opportunity for a hunting challenge that's offered to you and carry out those tasks with deadly precision. You're a hunter at heart and a valuable member of the Paw & Fur Society.
data.spoiler: Get the rank of Elite Hunter in the Killing in the Name of... Quest, Paw and Fur Ranks.

data.name: Elven Woods
data.description: Tall trees, deep forests and and the beauty of Ab'Dendriel - you really know every corner of the elven lands now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Ab'dendriel in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Ender of the End
data.description: You have entered the heart of destruction and valiantly defeated the world devourer. By your actions you have postponed the end of the world - at least for a while.
data.spoiler: Complete the Heart of Destruction Quest.

data.name: Ending the Horror
data.description: You have cleansed the lands of many retching horrors. You sure know how to end a bad dream: forcefully, that's how!
data.spoiler: Finish the mission A Retched Beginning during the Roshamuul Quest.

data.name: Engine Driver
data.description: This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.
data.spoiler: Get the Gloothomotive mount.

data.name: Enlightened, Indeed
data.description: You stared into the Light without blinking. Foolish or enlightened... who can tell?
data.spoiler: Get the full Illuminated Warrior Outfit.

data.name: Enter zze Draken!
data.description: You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
data.spoiler: Slay Paiz the Pauperizer.

data.name: Errand Runner
data.description: Your stash is cleared, your bestiary completed but the grind has only just begun.
data.spoiler: Complete 100 Weekly Tasks.

data.name: Exalted Battle Mage
data.description: Not only did you master the battlefield as a mage, you were also induced to the most inner secrets of the art of magical warfare and prevailed.
data.spoiler: Get both addons of the Battle Mage Outfit.

data.name: Exemplary Citizen
data.description: Every city should be proud to call someone like you its inhabitant. You're keeping the streets clean and help settling the usual disputes in front of the depot. Also, you probably own a cat and like hiking.
data.spoiler: Complete the Citizen Outfit.

data.name: Explorer
data.description: You've been to places most people don't even know the names of. Collecting botanic, zoologic and ectoplasmic samples is your daily business and you're always prepared to discover new horizons.
data.spoiler: Complete mission 2, The Spectral Dress, in The Explorer Society Quest.

data.name: Exquisite Taste
data.description: You love fish - but preferably those caught in the cold north. Even though they're hard to come by you never get tired of picking holes in ice sheets and hanging your fishing rod in.
data.spoiler: Catch 250 fish through Ice Fishing.

data.name: Exterminator
data.description: Efficient and lethal, you have gained significant experience in fighting the elite forces of the hive. Almost single-handed, you have slain the best of the Hive Born and live to tell the tale.
data.spoiler: Repeat Kollos Killing task 100 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Extreme Degustation
data.description: Almost all the plants you tested for Chartan in Zao where inedible - you tasted them all, yet you're still standing! You should really get some fresh air now, though.
data.spoiler: Complete the Daily Task: Collect from the Children of Revolution Quest.

data.name: Eye of the Deep
data.description: You didn't look into it - at least not for too long... but Groam did. And you relieved him. Just don't tell his friend Dronk.
data.spoiler: Kill Groam.

data.name: Fabled Construction
data.description: Finding all the pieces to this complicated vehicle was one kind of a challenge. However, what you built in the end is rather a fabled than a feeble construction.
data.spoiler: Tame a Glooth Glider.

data.name: Fairy Teasing
data.description: Teasing fairies is fun. They leave behind such pretty clouds of glittering dust when chased. Just hope they don't get you back for it.
data.spoiler: Make 100 Dancing Fairies disappear by using them. It also works if you click on a Small Plant House ("This is my house! Back off!")

data.name: Falconer
data.description: A true beastmaster learns the language of his animal companions. Now you as well can bolster your unique bond with nature and help preserve the balance of life as a proud falconer.
data.spoiler: Get the full Falconer Outfit.

data.name: Fall of the Fallen
data.description: Have you ever wondered how he reappears again and again? You only care for the loot, do you? Gotcha!
data.spoiler: Open Gnomevil's reward chest 50 times.

data.name: Fata Morgana
data.description: There are many delusions and phantasms in the desert. You saw a false oasis with fruit-bearing palm trees. Instead of water and refreshment, however, you found a dromedary in the end. What a useful Fata Morgana!
data.spoiler: Tame a Dromedary.

data.name: Fearless
data.description: You broke the jar of Horestis - fifty times. Either you know no fear or simply ignore it. Whatever the case, you are "fearless" indeed.
data.spoiler: Break 50 Ornate Canopic Jars in The Mummy's Curse World Change.

data.name: Feral Trapper
data.description: You've learned the way of the wilderness: its patience, its fury, its grace. As a feral trapper, you embody them all.
data.spoiler: Get the full Feral Trapper Outfit.

data.name: Fiend Rider
data.description: Riding such an ancient beast is certainly a good and harmless idea.
data.spoiler: Get the Primal Demonosaur mount by using a Demon In A Green Box.

data.name: Fiend Slayer
data.description: No living fiends were hurt to achieve this outfit.
data.spoiler: Get the full Fiend Slayer Outfit.

data.name: Final Strike
data.description: The mighty Deathstrike is dead! One legend is dead and you're on your way to become one yourself.
data.spoiler: Open the treasure chest of Deathstrike for the first time after slaying it.

data.name: Fire Devil
data.description: To keep the witches' fire burning, you trashed a lot of the wood the bane bringers animated. Some might find your fascination for fire ... disturbing.
data.spoiler: Use 100 Dry Pieces of Wood on the slide of the Bewitched event.

data.name: Fire from the Earth
data.description: You've survived the Hellgorge eruption and found a way through the flames and lava. You've even managed to kill a few fireborn on the way.
data.spoiler: Kill 50 fiery creatures in and on the Hellgore volcano during the Fire from the Earth Mini World Change.

data.name: Fire Lighter
data.description: You have helped to keep the witches fire burning. Just watch your fingers, it's hot!
data.spoiler: Use one Dry Piece of Wood on the slide during the Bewitched event.

data.name: Firefighter
data.description: You extinguished 500 thornfires! You were there when the Firestarters took over Shadowthorn. You saved the day - and the home of some elves which will try to kill you nonetheless. Isn't it nice to see everything restored just as it was before..?
data.spoiler: Extinguish 500 fires during the Thornfire world change.

data.name: Firewalker
data.description: Running barefoot across ember is not for you! You do it the elegant way. Yet, you're kind of drawn to fire and warm surroundings in general - you like it hot!
data.spoiler: Walk 1,000,000 tiles on fire while wearing Firewalker Boots.

data.name: Fireworks in the Sky
data.description: You love the moment right before your rocket takes off and explodes into beautiful colours - not only on new year's eve!
data.spoiler: Use 250 Fireworks Rockets on the floor.

data.name: First Achievement
data.description: Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
data.spoiler: Make a painting of the Colossus Fortress during the 25 Years of Tibia Quest.

data.name: Follower of Azerus
data.description: When you do something, you do it right. You have an opinion and you stand by it - and no one will be able to convince you otherwise. On a sidenote, you're a bit on the brutal and war-oriented side, but that's not a bad thing, is it?
data.spoiler: Complete mission 9 In Service of Yalahar Quest when you follow all of Yalahari (NPC)'s instructions.

data.name: Follower of Palimuth
data.description: You're a peacekeeper and listen to what the small people have to say. You've made up your mind and know who to help and for which reasons - and you do it consistently. Your war is fought with reason rather than weapons
data.spoiler: Complete mission 9 of In Service of Yalahar Quest when you follow all of Palimuth's instructions.

data.name: Fool at Heart
data.description: And remember: Never try to teach a pig to sing. It wastes your time and annoys the pig.
data.spoiler: Complete the Jester Outfit.

data.name: Forbidden Fruit
data.description: You could not resist the taste of the forbidden fruit. Since you don't feel changed at all, it couldn't have been that bad after all. Or could it?
data.spoiler: Eat a Forbidden Fruit.

data.name: Forbidden Knowledge
data.spoiler: Use a Key to Knowledge on a Forbidden Tome. This won't work if you have never eaten a Forbidden Fruit.

data.name: Fountain of Life
data.description: You found and took a sip from the Fountain of Life. Thought it didn't grant you eternal life, you feel changed and somehow at peace.
data.spoiler: Drink from the fountain of life in pits of inferno's entrance.

data.name: Free Items!
data.description: Yay! Finders keepers, losers weepers! Who cares where all that stuff came from and if you had to crawl through garbage piles to get it? It's FREE!
data.spoiler: Get 50 items from Crates.

data.name: Fried Shrimp
data.description: This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
data.spoiler: Tame a Crustacea Gigantica.

data.name: Friend of Elves
data.description: Kingly deer mostly prefer elves as friends and familiars. This one, however, decided to favour you as a confidant and rider. Well done!
data.spoiler: Tame an Enrage White Deer.

data.name: Friend of the Apes
data.description: You know Banuta like the back of your hand and are good at destroying caskets and urns. The sight of giant footprints doesn't keep you from exploring unknown areas either.
data.spoiler: Finish The Ape City Quest.

data.name: Friendly Fire
data.description: You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!
data.spoiler: Get the full Fire-Fighter Outfit.

data.name: Fully Decayed
data.description: You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly.
data.spoiler: Get the full Decaying Defender Outfit.

data.name: Funghitastic
data.description: Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
data.spoiler: Complete the Soil Guardian Outfit.

data.name: Gatherer
data.description: By killing creatures of the hive and gaining weapons for further missions, you started a quite effective way of war. You gathered a lot of dissolved chitin to resupply the war effort.
data.spoiler: Repeat Dissolved Chitin task 10 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Gear Up
data.description: Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
data.spoiler: Tame a Walker.

data.name: Gem Cutter
data.description: You cut your first gem - and it bears your own name! Now that would be a nice gift! This does not make it a "true" Heart of the Sea, however...
data.spoiler: Cut your first Heart of the Sea in the Liquid Black Quest.

data.name: Ghost Sailor
data.description: You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain. Despite the perils, you and your fellow crewmen have braved the challenge.
data.spoiler: Finish 1 journey in A Pirate's Death to Me.

data.name: Ghostwhisperer
data.description: You don't hunt them, you talk to them. You know that ghosts might keep secrets that have been long lost among the living, and you're skilled at talking them into revealing them to you.
data.spoiler: Obtainable by talking to Ghost of a Priest in the 4th mission of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest, finishing Blood Brothers Quest up to mission 5, Ice Islands Quest until mission Formorgar Mines 1 and maybe exchange one for Kissing a Pig Quest until mission 5.

data.name: Glooth Engineer
data.description: Though you might have averted a dire threat for Rathleton, this relative peace may only hold for a while. At least you've scavenged an outfit from some of the poor fellows that have fallen prey to death priest Shagron.
data.spoiler: Complete the Glooth Engineer Outfit.

data.name: Glooth Punk
data.description: Glooth is the substance that powers a whole continent and all its weird inhabitants, workshops and factories. You travelled this strange smorgasbord of curiosities in its entirety - just in time for tea.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Oramond in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Gnome Friend
data.description: The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your gib feet into areas few humans have walked before.
data.spoiler: Get rank II in the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Gnome Little Helper
data.description: You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
data.spoiler: Get rank I in the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Gnomebane's Bane
data.description: The fallen gnome is dead and justice served. But what was it that the gnome whispered with his last breath? He's your father???
data.spoiler: Open the treasure chest of Gnomevil for the first time after slaying him.

data.name: Gnomelike
data.description: You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
data.spoiler: Get rank III of Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Gnomish Art of War
data.description: You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
data.spoiler: Gain permanent access to the all warzones in the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Go with da Lava Flow
data.description: You escaped the glowing hot lava death trap, Professor Maxxen has set for you - Captain Caveworm is indeed proud!
data.spoiler: Complete the Into the Fire mission during the Hero of Rathleton Quest.

data.name: Godslayer
data.description: You have defeated the Snake God's incarnations and, with a final powerful swing of the snake sceptre, cut off his life force supply. The story of power, deceit and corruption has come to an end - or... not?
data.spoiler: Finish the Wrath of the Emperor Quest.

data.name: Gold Digger
data.description: Hidden treasures below the sand dunes of the desert - you have a nose for finding them and you know where to dig. They might not make you filthy rich, but they're shiny and pretty anyhow.
data.spoiler: Dig up 100 scarab coins in the desert.

data.name: Golden Sands
data.description: Counting ten thousand grains of sand could not have been harder than gaining this impressive mount.
data.spoiler: Tame a Sandstone Scorpion.

data.name: Goldhunter
data.description: If it wasn't for you, several banks in Tibia would've gotten bankrupt by now. Keep on chasing bank robbers and no one will have to worry about the Tibian economy!
data.spoiler: Return 5 Bags with Stolen Gold in total when the Bank Robbery Mini World Change is active.

data.name: Golem in the Gears
data.description: You're an aspiring mago-mechanic. Science and magic work well together in your eyes - and even though you probably delivered countless wrong charges while working for Telas, you might just have enough knowledge to build your own golem now.
data.spoiler: Complete Shadows of Yalahar Quest.

data.name: Goo Goo Dancer
data.description: Seeing a mucus plug makes your heart dance and you can't resist to see what it hides. Goo goo away!
data.spoiler: Use 100 Muck Removers on Mucus Plugs.

data.name: Gravedigger
data.description: Assisting Omrabas' sick plan to resurrect made you dig your way through the blood-soaked halls of Drefia. Maybe better he failed!
data.spoiler: Finish The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest.

data.name: Green Thumb
data.description: If someone gives you seeds, you usually grow a beautiful plant from it within a few days. You like your house green and decorated with flowers. Probably you also talk to them.
data.spoiler: Grow 100 fully developed flowers in Flower Pots.

data.name: Greenhorn
data.description: You wiped out Orcus the Cruel in the Arena of Svargrond. You're still a bit green behind the ears, but there's some great potential.
data.spoiler: Finish the Barbarian Arena Quest in the Greenhorn difficulty.

data.name: Grinding Again
data.description: Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
data.spoiler: Complete the Grindstone Hunt task of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Gryphon Rider
data.description: Unmasking spies, killing demons, discovering omens, solving puzzles and fighting ogres, manticores and feral sphinxes. - Nobody said it was easy to become a gryphon rider.
data.spoiler: Tame a Gryphon.

data.name: Guard Killer
data.description: You have proven that you can beat the best of the hive. You have caused first promising breaches in the defence of the hive
data.spoiler: Repeat Kollos Killing task 10 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Guardian Downfall
data.description: You ended the life of over three hundred Deepling Guards. Not quite the guardian of the Deeplings, are you?
data.spoiler: Kill 300 Deepling Guards.

data.name: Guinea Pig
data.description: True scientists know their equipment. Testing new inventions is essential daily work for any hard working researcher. You showed no fear and took all the new equipment from Spectulus and Sinclair for a spin.
data.spoiler: Complete mission 2 in Research and Development Quest.

data.name: Happy Farmer
data.description: Scythe swung over your shoulder, sun burning down on your back - you are a farmer at heart and love working in the fields. Or then again maybe you just create fancy crop circles to scare your fellow men.
data.spoiler: Cut 200 wheat with a Scythe or Squeezing Gear of Girlpower.

data.name: Hat Hunter
data.description: You sucessfully fought against all odds to protect your world from an ascending god! - You weren't there for the hat only after all?
data.spoiler: Complete the Ferumbras' Ascension Quest.

data.name: Headache
data.description: Even in the deepest structures of the hive, you began to strike against the mighty foe. Your actions probably already gave the hive a headache.
data.spoiler: Repeat Destroy The Hive Crystals task 10 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Heartbreaker
data.description: Trust? Love? Faithfulness? Pah! Antiquated sentiments. As long as you have fun, you do not mind stepping on lots of hearts. Preferably while wearing combat boots.
data.spoiler: While married, say marriage to one of the Marriage Officiant NPCs and tell them that your heart belongs to someone other than your marriage partner five times.

data.name: Heartburn
data.description: Never-tiring, you attack the inner organs of the mighty hive. Your attacks on the hive's digestion system begin to cause some trouble.
data.spoiler: Repeat Disrupt The Hives Digestion task 50 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Hell Rider
data.description: Pray it never finds its way back to its original stable with you still riding.
data.spoiler: Get the Hell Demonosaur mount by using a Demon in a Red Box.

data.name: Herbicide
data.description: You're one of the brave heroes to face and defeat the mysterious demon oak and all the critters it threw in your face. Wielding your blessed axe no tree dares stand in your way - demonic or not.
data.spoiler: Complete The Demon Oak Quest.

data.name: Here, Fishy Fishy!
data.description: Ah, the smell of the sea! Standing at the shore and casting a line is one of your favourite activities. For you, fishing is relaxing - and at the same time, providing easy food. Perfect!
data.spoiler: Fish 1000 Fish. Ice Fishing doesn't count.

data.name: Hickup
data.description: You have grown accustomed to frequenting the hive's stomach system. Your actions have caused the hive some first digestion problems.
data.spoiler: Repeat Disrupt The Hives Digestion task 10 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Hidden Powers
data.description: You've discovered the Ancients' hidden powers - from now on, they will aid you in your adventures.
data.spoiler: Charge a Helmet of the Ancients with a small ruby.

data.name: High and Dry
data.description: You asked Captain Charles to take a shortcut quite a few times. Now you are all too familiar with desert islands all over Tibia.
data.spoiler: Ask for a shortcut to Captain Charles in Port Hope and Shipwreck 30 times.

data.name: High Inquisitor
data.description: You're the one who poses the questions around here, and you know how to get the answers you want to hear. Besides, you're a famous exorcist and slay a few vampires and demons here and there. You and your stake are a perfect team.
data.spoiler: Finish The Inquisition Quest.

data.name: High-Flyer
data.description: The breeze in your hair, your fingers clutching the rim of your Carpet - that's how you like to travel. Faster! Higher! And a looping every now and then.
data.spoiler: Travel by Magic Carpet 1000 times.

data.name: Hippofoddermus
data.description: You did the hippo population of Kilmaresh a great favour. A well-fed hippo is a happy hippo.
data.spoiler: Feed 100 Hippos with Reed Balls around Kilmaresh.

data.name: His Days are Counted
data.description: You defeated the Count of the Core and destroyed his lava pump!
data.spoiler: Defeat The Count Of The Core in the Dangerous Depths Quest.

data.name: His True Face
data.description: You're one of the few Tibians who Armenius chose to actually show his true face to - and he made you fight him. Either that means you're very lucky or very unlucky, but one thing's for sure - it's extremely rare.
data.spoiler: Exact requirements for this achievement are still unknown, but there's a chance of getting it during mission 3 of the Blood Brothers Quest.

data.name: Hissing Downfall
data.description: You've vansquished the Noxious Spawn and his serpentine heart.
data.spoiler: Slay The Noxious Spawn.

data.name: Hive Blinder
data.description: You have put a lot of time and energy into keeping the hive unaware of what is happening on Quirefang. The hive learnt to fear your actions. It would surely crush you with all its might ... if it could only find you!
data.spoiler: Repeat Antenna Blinding task 100 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Hive Fighter
data.description: You have participated that much in the hive war, that you are able to create some makeshift armor from the remains of dead hive born that can be found in the major hive, to show of your skill.
data.spoiler: Earn 300 War Exp in War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Hive Infiltrator
data.description: The most powerful warriors of the hive were killed by you by the dozens. The hive is not safe anymore because of your actions.
data.spoiler: Repeat Kollos Killing task 50 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Hive War Veteran
data.description: Your invaluable experience in fighting the hive allows you to add another piece of armor to your chitin outfit to proove your dedication for the cause.
data.spoiler: Earn 500 War Exp in War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Hoard of the Dragon
data.description: Your adventurous way through countless dragon lairs earned you a pretty treasure - and surely the enmity of many a dragon.
data.spoiler: Complete The Great Dragon Hunt Quest 10 times.

data.name: Holzkopf
data.description: Things you do... for science.
data.spoiler: Use 100 Demon Roots.

data.name: Homebrewed
data.description: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum - homebrewed, of course, made from handpicked and personally harvested sugar cane plants. Now, let it age in an oak barrel and enjoy it in about 10 years. Or for the impatient ones: Let's have a paaaarty right now!
data.spoiler: Use 50 Bunches of Sugar Cane on a Distilling Machine.

data.name: Honest Finder
data.description: You've stopped the bank robber and returned the bag full of gold. Good to know there are still lawful Tibians like you around.
data.spoiler: Return a Bag with Stolen Gold to a bank when the Bank Robbery Mini World Change is active.

data.name: Honorary Barbarian
data.description: You've hugged bears, pushed mammoths and proved your drinking skills. And even though you have a slight hangover, a partially fractured rib and some greasy hair on your tongue, you're quite proud to call yourself a honorary barbarian from now on.
data.spoiler: Finish the Barbarian Test Quest.

data.name: Honorary Gnome
data.description: You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
data.spoiler: Reach rank IV of Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Honorary Rascoohan
data.description: When in Rascacoon, do as the Rascoohans do!
data.spoiler: Get the full Rascoohan Outfit.

data.name: Honorary Witch
data.description: Your efforts in fighting back the banebringers has not gone unnoticed. You are a legend amongst the witches and your name is whispered with awe and admiration.
data.spoiler: Throw 500 ingredients into the witches cauldron during the Bewitched event.

data.name: Hope of the Merudri
data.description: You followed the Three-Fold Path as did generations of Merudri before you. Carry the legacy, culture and hope of the Merudri proudly into this realm, the hearts of its people and beyond.
data.spoiler: Use all the shrines during The Way of the Monk Quest.

data.name: Hot on the Trail
data.description: Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!
data.spoiler: Get the Singeing Steed mount.

data.name: Howly Silence
data.description: You muted the everlasting howling of Hemming.
data.spoiler: Slay Hemming.

data.name: Hunting Permit
data.description: You have fully unlocked your very first monster in the cyclopedia.
data.spoiler: Unlock all details from any monster in your Bestiary.

data.name: Hunting with Style
data.description: At daytime you can be found camouflaged in the woods laying traps or chasing big game, at night you're sitting by the campfire and sharing your hunting stories. You eat what you hunted and wear what you skinned. Life could go on like that forever.
data.spoiler: Complete the Hunter Outfit.

data.name: Huntsman
data.description: You're familiar with hunting tasks and have carried out quite a few already. A bright career as hunter for the Paw & Fur society lies ahead!
data.spoiler: Get the rank of Huntsman in the Killing in the Name of... Quest, Paw and Fur Ranks.

data.name: I Did My Part
data.description: Your world is lucky to have you! You don't hesitate to jump in and help when brave heroes are called to save the world.
data.spoiler: Take part in a world quest.

data.name: I Like it Fancy
data.description: You definitely know how to bring out the best in your furniture and decoration pieces. Beautiful.
data.spoiler: Use a Small Enchanted Emerald on a Dracoyle Statue.

data.name: I Need a Hug
data.description: You and your stuffed furry friends are inseparable, and you're not ashamed to take them to bed with you - who knows when you will wake up in the middle of the night in dire need of a cuddle?
data.spoiler: Use Panda Teddy, Stuffed Dragon, Baby Seal Doll and Santa Doll one time each.

data.name: I Wanna Fly Away
data.description: ... on a pegasus, to a land of honey and milk. With this beautiful flying steed you certainly can.
data.spoiler: Get the Pegasus mount.

data.name: Ice Harvester
data.description: You witnessed the thawing of Svargrond and harvested rare seeds from some strange icy plants. They must be good for something.
data.spoiler: Harvest Ice Flowers and get 10 Ice Flower Seeds during the Thawing Mini World Change.

data.name: Ice Sculptor
data.description: You love to hang out in cold surroundings and consider ice the best material to be shaped. What a waste to use ice cubes for drinks when you can create a beautiful mammoth statue from it!
data.spoiler: Sculpt an Ice Mammoth from Ice Cubes by using an Obsidian Knife on it.

data.name: Icy Glare
data.description: Here's looking at you, kid. This ancient creature seems to size you up with its brilliant eyes and barely tolerates you riding it. Maybe it thinks you're the defrosted snack, after all?
data.spoiler: Tame a Half-Frozen Ursagrodon.

data.name: Illuminator
data.description: Joran and Yvette have brought the colours back to the world, and you have freed it from the monsters of this story. The world of books is now yours.
data.spoiler: Get the full Illuminator Outfit.

data.name: In Shining Armor
data.description: With edged blade and fully equipped in a sturdy full plate armor, you charge at your enemies with both strength and valour. There's always a maiden to save and a dragon to slay for you.
data.spoiler: Complete the Knight Outfit.

data.name: Inner Peace
data.description: The transcendence to a higher state of mind and existence in order to achieve inner peace has been amplified by various means throghout Medudri history. Among them a manifold of potions with varying potence - it seems some of them actually work...
data.spoiler: Use 100 Transcendence Potions.

data.name: Inquisition's Arm
data.description: Your special garb, solely awarded to a dedicated hand of the Inquisition, is now complete.
data.spoiler: Complete the Hand of the Inquisition Outfit.

data.name: Inquisition's Hand
data.description: You defeated the Lich Knights and became the hand of the Inquisition, allowed to wear their special garb.
data.spoiler: Defeat King Zelos in the Grave Danger Quest.

data.name: Interior Decorator
data.description: Your home is your castle - and the furniture in it is just as important. Your friends ask for your advice when decorating their Houses and your probably own every statue, rack and bed there is.
data.spoiler: Make 1000 purchases of Furniture Kits.

data.name: Invader of the Deep
data.description: Many creatures of the deep have lost their lives by your hand. Three hundred have entered the depths of eternity. You should probably fear the revenge of the Eyes of the Deep.
data.spoiler: Kill 300 Deepling Scouts.

data.name: Jamjam
data.description: When it comes to interracial understanding, you're an expert. You've mastered the language of the Chakoya and made someone really happy with your generosity. Achuq!
data.spoiler: Complete the Sinatuki Quest.

data.name: Jewel in the Swamp
data.description: Damp swamps, a dry desert and the opulence of Venore - you really know every corner of Eastern Mainland now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Venore in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Jinx
data.description: Sometimes you feel there's a gremlin in there. So many lottery tickets, so many blanks? That's just not fair! Share your misery with the world.
data.spoiler: Open 500 blank Lottery Tickets (winning tickets don't count).

data.name: Joke's on You
data.description: Well - the contents of that present weren't quite what you expected. With friends like these, who needs enemies?
data.spoiler: Open an Explosive Present.

data.name: Just Cracked Me Up!
data.description: Stonecracker's head was much softer than the stones he threw at you.
data.spoiler: Slay Stonecracker.

data.name: Just in Time
data.description: You're a fast runner and are good at delivering wares which are bound to decay just in the nick of time, even if you can't use any means of transportation or if your hands get cold or smelly in the process.
data.spoiler: Finish The Ice Delivery mission of The Explorer Society Quest and The Wednesday Mission of The Travelling Trader Quest.

data.name: Kapow!
data.description: No joke, you murdered the bat.
data.spoiler: Slay Bruise Payne.

data.name: Keeper of the 7 Keys
data.description: You found the Seven Keys to unlock ... no, not the seven seas. But at least seven doors in the realm of dreams.
data.spoiler: Solve all 7 key puzzles in The Dream Courts Quest.

data.name: Keeper of the Flame
data.description: One of the Lightbearers. One of those who helped to keep the basins burning and worked together against the darkness. The demonic whispers behind the thin veil between the worlds - they were silenced again thanks to your help.
data.spoiler: Take part in the Lightbearer Event.

data.name: King Of The Jungle
data.description: You have searched Port Hope and the jungle that thoroughly, that you are up to adoption by a friendly ape family.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Port Hope in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: King of the Ring
data.description: Bretzecutioner's body just got slammed away. You are a true king of the ring!
data.spoiler: Slay Bretzecutioner.

data.name: King Tibianus Fan
data.description: You're not sure what it is, but you feel drawn to royalty. Your knees are always a bit grazed from crawling around in front of thrones and you love hanging out in castles. Maybe you should consider applying as a guard?
data.spoiler: Finish The Isle of Evil Quest.

data.name: King's Council
data.description: Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
data.spoiler: Get the full Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfit.

data.name: Knock on Wood
data.description: It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
data.spoiler: Tame a Tin Lizzard.

data.name: Knowledge Raider
data.description: Your thirst for knowledge is insatiable. In the task of helping your gnomish friends, flawless execution is just the icing on the cake.
data.spoiler: Complete 50 consecutive tasks without failing in the Too Hot to Handle Quest

data.name: Lacewing Catcher
data.description: You caught a lacewing moth with your lantern. It will follow you in companionship as the the bearer of the lantern will be its guide through the darkness now.
data.spoiler: Tame a Lacewing Moth.

data.name: Let the Sunshine In
data.description: Rise and shine! It's a beautiful new day - open your windows, feel the warm sunlight, watch the birds singing on your windowsill and care for your plants. What reason is there not to be happy?
data.spoiler: Open house windows 100 times.

data.name: Liberty Bay Watch
data.description: A pirate's haven and a burglar's hideout. You found your way around Liberty Bay and its surroundings - land, ho!
data.spoiler: Fully discover Liberty Bay in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Library Liberator
data.description: Though you couldn't prevent the theft of the godbreaker knowledge, you still managed to fight of the invasion of the library and to kill the scourge of oblivion, a powerful servant of the enemy.
data.spoiler: Defeat The Scourge of Oblivion in The Secret Library Quest.

data.name: Life on the Streets
data.description: You're a beggar, homeless, wearing filthy and ragged clothes. But that doesn't mean you have to beg anyone for stuff - and you still kept your pride. Fine feathers do not necessarily make fine birds - what's under them is more important.
data.spoiler: Complete the Beggar Outfit.

data.name: Like Fox and Mouse
data.description: Sly as a fox, quiet as a mouse - the perfect mount for a stealthy foray.
data.spoiler: Tame a Foxmouse.

data.name: Lion King
data.description: By mastering the secrets of Lion's Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
data.spoiler: Tame a Noble Lion.

data.name: Lion's Den Explorer
data.description: You discovered the Lion's Rock, passed the tests to enter the inner sanctum and finally revealed the secrets of the buried temple. You literally put your head in the lion's mouth and survived.
data.spoiler: Complete the Lion's Rock Quest.

data.name: Lionheart
data.description: You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
data.spoiler: Finish The Order of the Lion Quest.

data.name: Little Adventure
data.description: You have fully unlocked 10 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
data.spoiler: Unlock all details from 10 easy monsters in your Bestiary.

data.name: Little Ball of Wool
data.description: You found a lost sheep and thus a steady source of black wool. But careful: don't get entangled.
data.spoiler: Tame a Black Sheep.

data.name: Little Big Adventure
data.description: You have fully unlocked 100 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
data.spoiler: Unlock all details from 100 easy monsters in your Bestiary.

data.name: Lizard Kingdom
data.description: From the southern steppe through the Dragonblaze Mountains and the Muggy Plains to the forbidden city of Razzachai - you really know every corner of Zao now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Zao in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Long Live the Queen
data.description: Ancient battlefields, amazons and the glory of Carlin - you really know every corner of Queen Eloise's realm now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Carlin in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Lord of the Elements
data.description: You travelled the surreal realm of the elemental spheres, summoned and slayed the Lord of the Elements, all in order to retrieve neutral matter. And as brave as you were, you couldn't have done it without your team!
data.spoiler: Finish The Elemental Spheres Quest.

data.name: Lord Protector
data.description: You proved yourself - not only in your dreams - and possess a strong and spiritual mind. Your valorous fight against demons and the undead plague has granted you the highest and most respected rank among the Nightmare Knights.
data.spoiler: Get the rank of Lord Protector of the Nightmare Knights faction in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest.

data.name: Lost Letters
data.description: Many letters have been written by knights of the Order of the Stag. Some personal while others were simply a mistake. We often ask ourselves what happened to these once corresponding souls, we hope for the best but have to fear for the worst.
data.spoiler: Read all 9 Personal Letters from the Isle of Ada mini bosses.

data.name: Lost Palace Raider
data.description: Lifting the secrets of a fabulous palace and defeating a beautiful demon princess was a thrilling experience indeed. This site's marvels nearly matched its terrors. Nearly.
data.spoiler: Complete The Lost Brother Quest and the Asura Palace Quest.

data.name: Lovely Dots
data.description: Finding a four-leaved clover is always a sign of luck. And as luck would have it, you even baited a lovely dotted ladybug. Lucky you!
data.spoiler: Tame a Ladybug.

data.name: Loyal Lad
data.description: Having a loyal friend alongside is comforting to every adventurer. If only this lad were not so stubborn...
data.spoiler: Tame a Donkey.

data.name: Loyal Subject
data.description: You joined the Kingsday festivities and payed King Tibianus your respects. Now, off to party!
data.spoiler: Say 'Hello King' to King Tibianus during the Kingsday Mini World Change.

data.name: Lucid Dreamer
data.description: Dreams - are your reality? Strange visions, ticking clocks, going to bed and waking up somewhere completely else - that was some trip, but you're almost sure you actually did enjoy it.
data.spoiler: Finish the Mission 4 of Dreamer's Challenge Quest.

data.name: Lucky Devil
data.description: That's almost too much luck for one person. If something's really, really rare - it probably falls into your lap sooner or later. Congratulations!
data.spoiler: Fish a Leviathan's Amulet from the corpse of a Water Elemental or Massive Water Elemental AND unrust a Golden Armor out of a Rusty Armor (Rare).

data.name: Lucky Horseshoe
data.description: 'Sweets for my steed' could be your motto. An impressive horse is eating out of your hand. Saddle up and be ready to find adventure, new friends, and maybe someone to shoe your horse now and then.
data.spoiler: Tame a Wild Horse.

data.name: Luminous Kitty
data.description: You made some efforts to bring a little more light into the world. And what a nice present you got in return!
data.spoiler: Light all 10 basins during the Lightbearer event and claim your Blazebringer mount with Santa Claus.

data.name: Luring Silence
data.description: What a scientific discovery - they really DO communicate! Using their own communication habits against them, you lured a large pack of silencers away from the walls of Roshamuul.
data.spoiler: Finish the mission Luring Silencers during the Roshamuul Quest.

data.name: Mageslayer
data.description: You killed the raging mage in his tower south of Zao. Again. But this one just keeps coming back. The dimensional portal collapsed once more and you know he will eventually return but hey - a raging mage, it's like asking for it...
data.spoiler: Kill the Energized Raging Mage twice.

data.name: Magnetised
data.description: This magnetic beast attracted you in a very literal way. Or was it attracted by your metal equipment? Anyway, you seem to be stuck together now.
data.spoiler: Tame an Ironblight.

data.name: Mainstreet Nightmare
data.description: Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment.
data.spoiler: Get the full Poltergeist Outfit.

data.name: Make a Wish
data.description: But close your eyes and don't tell anyone what you wished for, or it won't come true!
data.spoiler: Blow out the candle of 5 Party Cakes.

data.name: Malefitz
data.description: Made acquaintance with three brothers Fitz.
data.spoiler: Deliver Fitzwilliam's Special Reserve to Fitzmaurice

data.name: Manic
data.description: You have destroyed a significant amount of the hive's vital nerve centres and caused massive destruction to the hive's awareness. You are probably causing the hive horrible nightmares.
data.spoiler: Repeat Destroy The Hive Crystals task 100 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Marble Madness
data.description: Your little statues of Tibiasula have become quite famous around Tibia and there's few people with similar skills when it comes to shaping marble.
data.spoiler: Make five Beautiful Marble Statues from a Piece of Marble Rock.

data.name: Marblelous
data.description: You're an aspiring marble sculptor with promising skills - proven by the perfect little Tibiasula statue you shaped. One day you'll be really famous!
data.spoiler: Make a Beautiful Marble Statue from a Piece of Marble Rock.

data.name: Marid Ally
data.description: You've proven to be a valuable ally to the Marid, and Gabel welcomed you to trade with Haroun and Nah'Bob whenever you want to. Though the Djinn war has still not ended, the Marid can't fail with you on their side.
data.spoiler: Finish The Djinn War - Marid Faction.

data.name: Masquerader
data.description: You probably don't know anymore how you really look like - usually when you look into a mirror, some kind of monster stares back at you. On the other hand - maybe that's an improvement?
data.spoiler: Use 100 Costume Bags of Stan.

data.name: Master Debater
data.description: You truly are the grand master of verbal debate! Now going forth and putting this wisdom to good use in everyday life... is probably debatable.
data.spoiler: Get all books of The Grand Master of Verbal Debate and defeat Grand Master Oberon in The Secret Library Quest.

data.name: Master Hunter
data.description: You have fully unlocked 100 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
data.spoiler: Unlock all details from 100 hard monsters in your Bestiary.

data.name: Master of the Nexus
data.description: You were able to fight your way through the countless hordes in the Demon Forge. Once more you proved that nothing is impossible.
data.spoiler: Finish The Inquisition Quest.

data.name: Master of War
data.description: You're not afraid to show your colours in the heat of battle. Enemies fear your lethal lance and impenetrable armor. The list of the wars you've won is impressive. Hail and kill!
data.spoiler: Complete the Warmaster Outfit.

data.name: Master Shapeshifter
data.description: You have mastered Kuriks challenge in all possible shapes.
data.spoiler: Change into every possible (8) forms during Last Creep Standing Event.

data.name: Master Thief
data.description: Robbing, inviting yourself to VIP parties, faking contracts and pretending to be someone else - you're a jack of all trades when it comes to illegal activities. You take no prisoners, except for the occasional goldfish now and then.
data.spoiler: Finish The Thieves Guild Quest.

data.name: Mastermind
data.description: You feel you could solve the hardest riddles within a minute or so. Plus, there's a nice boost on your spell damage. All in a little bottle. Aftereffects - feeling slightly stupid. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
data.spoiler: Drink 100 Mastermind Potions.

data.name: Matchmaker
data.description: You don't believe in romance to be a coincidence or in love at first sight. In fact - love potions, bouquets of flowers and cheesy poems do the trick much better than ever could. Keep those hormones flowing!
data.spoiler: Complete Mission 3: Love's a Wicked Game of The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest, or Mission 4: Breaking the Spell of The Shattered Isles Quest.

data.name: Mathemagician
data.description: Sometimes the biggest secrets of life can have a simple solution.
data.spoiler: Talk with 'A Prisoner' in Paradox Tower Quest.

data.name: Measuring the World
data.description: Step by step you discovered many of the secrets hidden in the world, thus gaining the right to wear the Discoverer outfit and hat. Made-to-measure for a brave traveller of the Tibian wilds.
