data.spoiler: Get the second addon of the Discoverer Outfit.

data.name: Meat Skewer
data.description: You've impaled the big mammoth Bloodtusk with his own tusks.
data.spoiler: Slay Bloodtusk.

data.name: Merry Adventures
data.description: You went into the forest, met Rottin Wood and the Married Men and helped them out in their camp. Oh, and don't worry about those merchants. They won't dare mentioning the strangely large sums of gold they actually possessed which are missing now.
data.spoiler: Finish the Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest.

data.name: Millennial Falcon
data.description: You defeated Grand Master Oberon and the remnants of the Order of the Falcon, no matter the odds.
data.spoiler: Defeat Grand Master Oberon in The Secret Library Quest.

data.name: Mimic
data.description: Apparently not all chests are the same. Some have a life of their own and if you think about it... how do so many of them actually refill every day? Well, you're one step closer to revealing this secret

data.name: Mind the Dog!
data.description: Barking dogs never bite, as the saying goes. But this one clearly tried. In the end, however, you were able to walk the dog - ahem, gnarlhound.
data.spoiler: Tame a Modified Gnarlhound.

data.name: Mind The Step!
data.description: You've got a mind ready to draw strange conclusions that defy the laws of logic and sidestep reality. Or maybe it's just a lucky guess - or adventurous recklessness?
data.spoiler: Obtain The Orb of Darkness Eternal in Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest.

data.name: Minor Disturbance
data.description: Your actions start to make a difference. You have blinded the antennae of the hive often enough to become an annoyance to it.
data.spoiler: Repeat Antenna Blinding task 10 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Minstrel
data.description: You can handle any music instrument you're given - and actually manage to produce a pleasant sound with it. You're a welcome guest and entertainer in most taverns
data.spoiler: Get the Rockstar achievement, then play the Musical Instruments in the correct order to access Vashresamun's room.

data.name: Mister Sandman
data.description: Tired... so tired... curling up in a warm and cosy bed seems like the perfect thing to do right now. Sweet dreams!
data.spoiler: Use a bed or a cot 500 times (logging out).

data.name: Modest Guest
data.description: You don't need much to sleep comfortably. A pile of straw and a roof over your head - with the latter being completely optional - is quite enough to relax. You don't even mind the rats nibbling on your toes.
data.spoiler: Sleep on a Straw Mat 100 times.

data.name: Monsterhunter
data.description: Fear me, monsters! There is some more slaying to come!
data.spoiler: Complete 200 Adept Weekly Kill Tasks.

data.name: Moth Whisperer
data.description: Your lantern was too bewitching for a hibernal moth. It couldn't withstand and follows you, the bearer of the lantern, now.
data.spoiler: Tame a Hibernal Moth.

data.name: Mummy's Dearest
data.description: You have combed the desert and searched the pyramid city of Ankrahmun.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Ankrahmun in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Museum Goer
data.description: You unveiled the secret plot of the Mitmah who stole away an entire civilisation for their own entertainment. Let the death of their outpost vanguard be an eternal lesson to them.
data.spoiler: Defeat Mitmah Vanguard.

data.name: Mutagenius
data.description: You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours.
data.spoiler: Complete the mutagen task of The Cradle of Monsters Quest while having all 16 mutagens in the same colour.

data.name: Mutated Presents
data.description: Muahahaha it's a... mutated pumpkin! After helping to take it down - you DID help, didn't you? - you claimed your reward and got a more or less weird present. Happy Halloween!
data.spoiler: Skin The Mutated Pumpkin's dead body.

data.name: Mystic Fabric Magic
data.description: You vanquished the mad mage, you subdued the raging mage - no spellweaving self-exposer can stand in your way. Yet you are quite absorbed in magical studies yourself. This very fabric reflects this personal approval of the magic arts.
data.spoiler: Complete the Elementalist Outfit.

data.name: Mystic Predator
data.description: Proving your true worth to a mystic creature like the jaguar, king of the hunt, granted you not only respect but also its heart.
data.spoiler: Tame a Mystic Jaguar.

data.name: Nanny from Hell
data.description: You have cheered up a bunch of demon babies and returned them to their mother. Don't bother the burn marks, don't bother the strains of grey hair, don't bother the nights you wake up screaming. It was worth it ... probably ... somehow.
data.spoiler: Successfully take care of a Demon Infant during the Demon's Lullaby event for 5 years.

data.name: Natural Born Cowboy
data.description: Oh, the joy of riding! You've just got your very first own mount. Conveniently enough you don't even need stables, but can summon it any time you like.
data.spoiler: Tame your first mount.

data.name: Natural Sweetener
data.description: Liberty Bay is the perfect hangout for you and harvesting sugar cane quite a relaxing leisure activity. Would you like some tea with your sugar, hon?
data.spoiler: Cut 50 Sugar Canes.

data.name: Navigational Error
data.description: You confronted the Navigator.
data.spoiler: Speak with Navigator (during the Liquid Black Quest).

data.name: Nestling
data.description: You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
data.spoiler: Kill Mamma Longlegs 3 times in the Spider Nest Mini World Change.

data.name: Nether Pirate
data.description: Not fearing death or ghosts you have traveled with the ghost captain several times and are a seasoned traveler of the netherworld. The dead and the living whisper about your exploits with appreciation.
data.spoiler: Finish 10 journeys in A Pirate's Death to Me.

data.name: Never Surrender
data.description: You did not show any signs of surrender to any sight of... you get the picture. Even a hundred of them did not pose a threat to you.
data.spoiler: Kill 100 Sights of Surrender.

data.name: Nevermending Story
data.description: You collected all of the mysterious bottle messages around the island of Roshamuul and located the remains of the first mate. Time will tell if his tale of mending an evil ring holds true.
data.spoiler: Obtainable by fishing all 11 Messages in a Bottle out of the water during the Roshamuul Quest and then finding the first mate.

data.name: Nightmare Knight
data.description: You follow the path of dreams and that of responsibility without self-centered power. Free from greed and selfishness, you help others without expecting a reward.
data.spoiler: Join the Nightmare Knights in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest.

data.name: Nightmare Walker
data.description: You do not fear nightmares, you travel in them - facing countless horrors and fighting the fate they're about to bring. Few believe the dark prophecies you bring back from those dreams, but those who do fight alongside you as Nightmare Knights.
data.spoiler: Complete the Nightmare Outfit.

data.name: No Horse Open Sleigh
data.description: This sleigh is not driven by magic but pushed by a percht. Hopefully you two get along well together...!
data.spoiler: Get any Percht Sleigh from Frosty by giving him a Percht Skull.

data.name: No More Hiding
data.description: You've found a well-hidden spider queen and caught her off guard in the middle of her meal.
data.spoiler: Slay Hide.

data.name: Noblesse Obliterated
data.description: After a battle like this you know who your friends are.
data.spoiler: Kill Prince Drazzak in the Roshamuul Prison.

data.name: Nomad Soul
data.description: Home is where your current favourite hunting ground is, and though you might hold certain places more dear than others you never feel attached enough to really stay in one city for long. Pack all your stuff - it's time to move on again.
data.spoiler: Become a citizen of Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Edron, Farmine, Kazordoon, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Svargrond, Thais, Venore, and Yalahar.

data.name: Nothing but Hot Air
data.description: You have tamed the ghostly mists to do your bidding. For now ...
data.spoiler: Get the Haze mount.

data.name: Nothing Can Stop Me
data.description: You laugh at unprepared adventurers stuck in high grass or rush wood. Or maybe you actually do help them out. They call you... 'Machete'.
data.spoiler: Use a Machete, a Heavy Machete or a secret agent tool 100 times on Jungle Grass.

data.name: Number of the Beast
data.description: Six. Six. Six.
data.spoiler: Roll a 6 three times in a row with a die.

data.name: Of Wolves and Bears
data.description: One with nature, one with wildlife. Raw and animalistic power, sharpened senses, howling on the highest cliffs and roaring in the thickest forests - that's you.
data.spoiler: Complete the Druid Outfit.

data.name: Ogre Chef
data.description: You didn't manage to become an ogre chief. But at least you are, beyond doubt, a worthy ogre chef.
data.spoiler: Complete the The Chieftain's Menu mission of the Krailos Quest 3 times.

data.name: One Foot Vs. Many
data.description: One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gomes are wrong and size matters?
data.spoiler: Complete the Exterminators task of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: One Less
data.description: The Many is no more, but how many more are there? One can never know.
data.spoiler: Slay The Many.

data.name: One Thousand and One
data.description: You feel at home under the hot desert sun with sand between your toes, and your favourite means of travel is a flying carpet. Also, you can probably do that head isolation dance move.
data.spoiler: Complete the Oriental Outfit.

data.name: Oops
data.description: So much for your feathered little friend! Maybe standing in front of the birdcage, squeezing its neck and shouting 'Sing! Sing! Sing!' was a little too much for it?!
data.spoiler: Use a birdcage until the bird dies from a heart attack.

data.name: Orcsoberfest Welcome
data.description: The Orcsoberfest is not only known for its tradtional food, beer and customs but also fun events and excitement! You took part in all of that and can now truly say: "I survived!"
data.spoiler: Win at least once in all games from Orcsoberfest. Including: boss King Chuck, vomit cleaning and pig feeding.

data.name: Out in the Snowstorm
data.description: Snow heaps and hailstorms can't keep you from where you want to go. You're perfectly equipped for any expedition into the perpetual ice and know how to keep your feet warm. If you're a woman, that's quite an accomplishment, too.
data.spoiler: Complete the Norseman Outfits.

data.name: Out of the Stone Age
data.description: What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
data.spoiler: Tame an Undead Cavebear.

data.name: Over the Moon
data.description: The Curse of the Full Moon transforms harmless citizens into feral beasts. But with your help, Edron and Cormaya are safe - fairly.
data.spoiler: Finish The Curse of the Full Moon and The Curse Spreads missions of the Grimvale Quest.

data.name: Party Animal
data.description: Oh my god, it's a paaaaaaaaaaaarty! You're always in for fun, friends and booze and love being the center of attention. There's endless reasons to celebrate! Woohoo!
data.spoiler: Use a Party Trumpet or Party Hat 200 times.

data.name: Passionate Kisser
data.description: For you, a kiss is more than a simple touch of lips. You kiss maidens and deadbeats alike with unmatched affection and faced death and rebirth through the kiss of the banshee queen. Lucky are those who get to share such an intimate moment with you!
data.spoiler: Finish the Kissing a Pig Quest.

data.name: Peazzekeeper
data.description: You're a humble warrior who doesn't need wealth or specialised equipment for travelling and fighting. You feel at home in the northern lands of Zao and did your part in fighting its corruption.
data.spoiler: Complete the Wayfarer Outfit.

data.name: Pecking Order
data.description: Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
data.spoiler: Tame a Terror Bird.

data.name: Perfect Fool
data.description: You love playing jokes on others and tricking them into looking a little silly. Wagging tongues say that the moment of realisation in your victims' eyes is the reward you feed on, but you're probably just kidding and having fun with them... right??
data.spoiler: Finish What a foolish Quest.

data.name: Personal Nightmare
data.description: It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
data.spoiler: Tame a Shock Head.

data.name: Pest Control
data.description: From rotworms in caves to dragons in the sky, no creature is safe from your overzealous swatting.
data.spoiler: Complete 10,000 Bounty Tasks of any difficulty.

data.name: Petrologist
data.description: Stones have always fascinated you. So has the chance of finding something really precious inside one of them. Statistically you should've discovered a few nice treasures by now. But then again, most statistics are overriden by Mother Disfortune.
data.spoiler: Use a pick on 100 Shiny stones.

data.name: Phantastic!
data.description: This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!
data.spoiler: Get the Phant mount.

data.name: Piece of Cake
data.description: Life can be so easy with the right cake at the right time - and you mastered baking many different ones, so you should be prepared for almost everything life decides to throw at you.
data.spoiler: Bake one Chocolate Cake and one Decorated Cake.

data.name: Pied Piper
data.description: You are not exactly the Pied Piper of Hamelin but at least you managed to fend off a decent amount of pirats and helped to keep them out of the cities.
data.spoiler: Get 5000 points with Eustacio in A Pirate's Tail Quest.

data.name: Pig-Headed
data.description: Whoa, sow long! This boar is like a force of nature, breaking through the undergrowth of all the Tibian forests and all records of speed. Hang on!
data.spoiler: Tame a Boar.

data.name: Pimple
data.description: You are getting more and more experienced in destroying the supply of the enemy's forces. Your actions caused the hive some severe skin problems.
data.spoiler: Repeat Pore Stuffing task 50 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Plant vs. Minos
data.description: You have defeated the wallbreaker and saved the glooth plant.
data.spoiler: Help to defeat the Minotaur Wallbreaker.

data.name: Planter
data.description: The hive has to be fought with might and main, hampering its soldiers is only the first step. You diligently stopped the pores of the hive to spread its warriors.
data.spoiler: Repeat Pore Stuffing task 10 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Poet Laureate
data.description: Poems, verses, songs and rhymes you've recited many times. You have passed the cryptic door, raconteur of ancient lore. Even elves you've left impressed, so it seems you're truly blessed.
data.spoiler: Finish mission 3 of Kissing a Pig Quest, find the poem book at the Great Pyramid in Ankrahmun, and then enter the first 'endless' door of Dipthrah's chambers (Mountain Tomb).

data.name: Polisher
data.description: If you see a rusty item, you can't resist polishing it. There's always a little flask of rust remover in your inventory - who knows, there might be a golden armor beneath all that dirt!
data.spoiler: Successfully polish a combined total of 1000 Rusty Armors, Rusty Helmets, Rusty Legs, and Rusty Shields.

data.name: Potion Addict
data.description: Your local magic trader considers you one of his best customers - you usually buy large stocks of potions so you won't wake up in the middle of the night craving for more. Yet, you always seem to run out of them too fast. Cheers!
data.spoiler: Drink 100,000 potions.

data.name: Power of Words
data.description: The pen is mightier than the sword. In a way, yes, you have had this experience. You have seen with your own eyes what the power of words can do, the written word, to be precise.
data.spoiler: Complete the Between the Lines Quest.

data.name: Preservationist
data.description: You are a pretty smart thinker and managed to create everlasting flowers. They might become a big hit with all the people who aren't blessed with a green thumb or just forgetful.
data.spoiler: Use Ice Flower Seeds on a fully grown plant in a Flower Pot.

data.name: Principled
data.description: You have your principles and that is also reflected in your vote for the crew of the Great Expedition.
data.spoiler: Vote for the same option (all A or all B) the 7 days of the Great Expedition.

data.name: Prison Break
data.description: Gaz'haragoth... a day to remember! Your world accomplished someting really big - and you have been part of it!
data.spoiler: Help to kill Gaz'haragoth.

data.name: Prospectre
data.description: You made acquaintance with the Thaian. A strange contemporary with a dark history. No man but a derivate of green and obsession.
data.spoiler: Defeat The Thaian in the Feaster of Souls Quest.

data.name: Publicity
data.description: You are a man of the public. Or of good publicity at least. Through your efforts in advertising the airtight cloth, Zeronex might yet be redeemed - and Rathleton might yet see its first working Gloud Ship.
data.spoiler: Complete the Glooth Factory Quest - The Gloud Ship.

data.name: Purrfectly Addicted
data.description: Psss psss psss ...
data.spoiler: Use a Catnip 100 times.

data.name: Pwned a Lot of Fur
data.description: You've faced and defeated a lot of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
data.spoiler: Kill The Snapper, Hide, Deathbine, The Bloodtusk, Shardhead, Esmeralda, Fleshcrawler, Ribstride, The Bloodweb, Thul, The Old Widow, Flameborn, Sulphur Scuttler, The Many, The Noxious Spawn, Gorgo, Stonecracker, Leviathan, Kerberos and Ethershreck in the Killing in the Name of... Quest.

data.name: Pwned All Fur
data.description: You've faced and defeated each of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
data.spoiler: Kill all bosses in the Killing in the Name of... Quest.

data.name: Pyromaniac
data.description: Love ... fire! So ... shiny! Must ... buuuurrrn!
data.spoiler: Use 500 Dry Pieces of Wood during the Bewitched event.

data.name: Quick as a Turtle
data.description: There... is... simply... no... better... way - than to travel on the back of a turtle. At least you get to enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Laguna.
data.spoiler: Travel by the sea turtle on Laguna Islands 2000 times.

data.name: Race to the Pole
data.description: You have expelled the fog of the unknown from the islands of Svargrond. Maybe not as first, but that's not what matters in the end.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Svargrond in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Radiant Nimbus
data.description: On top of a cloud, the sun is always shining.
data.spoiler: Tame a Radiant Nimbus.

data.name: Raider in the Dark
data.description: But can you truly be one of them?
data.spoiler: Complete the Percht Raider Outfit.

data.name: Rathleton Citizen
data.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Citizen.
data.spoiler: Reach the rank of Citizen in the Rathleton Quest.

data.name: Rathleton Commoner
data.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Commoner.
data.spoiler: Reach the rank of Commoner in the Rathleton Quest.

data.name: Rathleton Inhabitant
data.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Inhabitant.
data.spoiler: Reach the rank of Inhabitant in the Rathleton Quest.

data.name: Rathleton Squire
data.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Squire.
data.spoiler: Reach the rank of Squire  in the Rathleton Quest.

data.name: Razing!
data.description: People with sharp canine teeth better beware of you, especially at nighttime, or they might find a stake between their ribs. You're a merciless vampire hunter and have gathered numerous tokens as proof.
data.spoiler: Get the rank of Razing! in the Vampire Hunter Quest.

data.name: Razor's Edge
data.description: That has been a close call ...
data.spoiler: Defeat The Gravedigger while having 18 or more stacks.

data.name: Realms of Dreams
data.description: Lush meadows, colourful fairies and sentient stones - you really know every corner of Feyrist now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Feyrist in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Reason to Celebrate
data.description: You met the legendary First Dragon and survived. That's a reason to celebrate for sure.
data.spoiler: Complete the Festive Outfit.

data.name: Recognised Trader
data.description: You're a talented merchant who's able to handle wares with care, finds good offers and digs up rares every now and then. Never late to complete an order, you're a reliable trader - at least in Rashid's eyes.
data.spoiler: Finish the The Travelling Trader Quest.

data.name: Release the Kraken
data.description: Riding around on this squishy companion gives you the feeling of flying through the air... uhm... swimming through the seven seas!
data.spoiler: Get the Krakoloss mount by defeating Tentugly's Head in A Pirate's Tail Quest.

data.name: Repenter
data.description: You cleansed your soul in serving the Repenter enclave and purified thine self in completing all tasks in a single day of labour.
data.spoiler: Do all tasks of The Repenters Quest and then ask for a bonus.

data.name: Rhino Rider
data.description: Don't forget, even your rhino sometimes needs a hug. A careful one in this case.
data.spoiler: Tame a Stone Rhino.

data.name: Rift Warrior
data.description: You went through hell. Seven times. You defeated the demons. Countless times. You put an end to Ferumbras' claims to ascendancy. Once and for all.
data.spoiler: Complete the Rift Warrior Outfit Quest.

data.name: Ripp-Ripp Hooray!
data.description: Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your ripptor.
data.spoiler: Get the Ripptor mount by unlocking hazard level 6 in Gnomprona.

data.name: Ritualist
data.description: You could be the author of the magnum opus 'How to Summon the Ultimate Beast from the Infernal Depths, Volume I'. Or, if your mind and heart are pure, you rather summon beings to help others. Or maybe just a little cat to have someone to cuddle.
data.spoiler: Complete the male Summoner Outfit or the female Mage Outfit.

data.name: Robo Chop
data.description: You have defeated the glooth bomb and chopped down a lot of metal monsters on your way.
data.spoiler: Help to defeat the Glooth Bomb.

data.name: Rock Me to Sleep
data.description: Sleeping - you do it with style. You're chilling in your hammock, listening to the sound of the birds and crickets as you slowly drift away into the realm of dreams.
data.spoiler: Use a hammock 100 times (logging out).

data.name: Rocket in Pocket
data.description: Either you are not a fast learner or you find some pleasure in setting yourself on fire. Or you're just looking for a fancy title. In any case, you should know that passing gas during your little donkey experiments is not recommended.
data.spoiler: Use 3 Fireworks Rockets in your backpack.

data.name: Rockstar
data.description: Music just comes to you naturally. You feel comfortable on any stage, at any time, and secretly hope that someday you will be able to defeat your foes by playing music only. Rock on!
data.spoiler: Play Musical Instruments 10,000 times.

data.name: Rollercoaster
data.description: Up and down and up and down... and then the big looping! Wait - they don't build loopings in Kazordoon. But ore wagon rides are still fun!
data.spoiler: Travel by ore wagon 100 times.

data.name: Rootless Behaviour
data.description: You've descended into the swampy depths of Deathbine's lair and made quick work of it.
data.spoiler: Slay Deathbine.

data.name: Royalty of Hazard
data.description: For some it can't be hazardous enough.
data.spoiler: Defeat The Primal Menace at hazard level 11.

data.name: Rubber Ducking
data.description: As an avid collector you managed to complete a full set of rubber ducks during the Great Expedition and traded it for a unique noble bath tub! Given you will acquire even more ducks in the future, this is the proper way to launch them!

data.name: Rumble In the Plant
data.description: You have defeated the tremor worm - and wonder what kind of fish you'd be able to catch with such a bait
data.spoiler: Defeat the Tremor Worm.

data.name: Running the Rift
data.description: You don't just have a permission to ride a rift runner, you literally went through hell and earned it!
data.spoiler: Tame a Rift Runner.

data.name: Ruthless
data.description: You've touched all thrones of The Ruthless Seven and absorbed some of their evil spirit. It may have changed you forever.
data.spoiler: Finish The Pits of Inferno Quest.

data.name: Safely Stored Away
data.description: Don't worry, no one will be able to take it from you. Probably.
data.spoiler: Step on tile next to depot 1000 times.

data.name: Sail Away!
data.description: Your outstanding work towards the launch of the Great Expedition turned out well for you. You decided it's time to take a break and the Landsailer for a spin! May you always have wind in your sails and a hand-width of even ground under your wheels!
data.spoiler: Get the Landsailer mount by exchanging 140 points during the Great Expedition.

data.name: Santa's Li'l Helper
data.description: Christmas is your favourite time of the year, and boy, do you love presents. Buy some nice things for your friends, hide them away until - well, until you decide to actually unwrap them rather yourself.
data.spoiler: Open 25 Christmas Bundles (any color).

data.name: Scales and Tail
data.description: The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
data.spoiler: Tame a Draptor.

data.name: Scorched Flames
data.description: A mighty blaze went out today. It's Flameborn's turn to wait for his rebirth in the eternal cycle of life and death.
data.spoiler: Slay Flameborn.

data.name: Scourge of Death
data.description: You are a master of the nether sea and have traveled with the ghost captain so many times that you know his ship and the perils of the nether sea inside out. You laugh in the face of death and may return as a ghost pirate yourself in the afterlife!
data.spoiler: Finish 50 journeys in A Pirate's Death to Me.

data.name: Scourge of Scarabs
data.description: You took the heat and defeated the Ancient Spawn of Morgathla!
data.spoiler: Defeat Ancient Spawn of Morgathla in the Dangerous Depths Quest.

data.name: Scrapper
data.description: You put out the Spirit of Fire's flames in the arena of Svargrond. Arena fights are for you - fair, square, with simple rules and one-on-one battles.
data.spoiler: Finish the Barbarian Arena Quest in the Scrapper difficulty.

data.name: Sculptor Apprentice
data.description: Granted, you didn't carve those lifelike animal figurines yourself. But helping a medusa to find proper objects and even watching her using her petrifying gaze is almost as rewarding.
data.spoiler: Finish Fafnar's Wrath mission in the Kilmaresh Quest and deliver the following items to Alyxo: Small Tortoise, a Bat, a Scorpion, a Scared Frog and a Calamary.

data.name: Sea Scout
data.description: Not even the hostile underwater environment stops you from doing your duty for the Explorer Society. Scouting the Quara realm is a piece of cake for you.
data.spoiler: Do The Undersea Kingdom and The Frozen Trench missions in The Explorer Society Quest.

data.name: Seasoned Adventurer
data.description: Adventure is your middle name. You spent much time in dangerous lands and have seen things others only dream of. You know your way around in Tibia - you are a seasoned adventurer now. And your journey has only just begun!
data.spoiler: Achieve level 50.

data.name: Secret Agent
data.description: Pack your spy gear and get ready for some dangerous missions in service of a secret agency. You've shown you want to - but can you really do it? Time will tell.
data.spoiler: Start the Secret Service Quest.

data.name: Serious Contender
data.description: You have fully unlocked 100 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
data.spoiler: Unlock all details from 100 medium monsters in your Bestiary.

data.name: Shaburak Nemesis
data.description: You are now the public archenemy of the Shaburak, prince slayer.
data.spoiler: Kill 100 Shaburak Prince.

data.name: Sharp Dressed
data.description: Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
data.spoiler: Get the full Formal Dress Outfit.

data.name: Sharpshooter
data.description: Improved eyesight, arrows and bolts flying at the speed of light and pinning your enemies with extra damage. All in a little bottle. No consumption of carrots required. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
data.spoiler: Drink 100 Bullseye Potions.

data.name: Shell Seeker
data.description: You found a hundred beautiful pearls in large sea shells. By now that necklace should be finished - and hopefully you didn't get your fingers squeezed too often during the process.
data.spoiler: Find 100 Giant Shimmering Pearls out of closed large seashells.

data.name: Shell We Take a Ride
data.description: Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
data.spoiler: Get the Shellodon mount.

data.name: Ship's Kobold
data.description: You've probably never gotten seasick in your life - you love spending your free time on the ocean and covered quite a lot of miles with ships. Aren't you glad you didn't have to swim all that?
data.spoiler: Travel by ship around 1250 times.

data.name: Si, Ariki!
data.description: You've found the oriental traveller Yasir and were able to trade with him - even if you didn't really understand his language.
data.spoiler: Trade for first time with NPC Yasir.

data.name: Silent Pet
data.description: Awww. Your very own little goldfish friend - he's cute, he's shiny and he can't complain should you forget to feed him. He'll definitely brighten up your day!
data.spoiler: Catch a Small Fish with an Empty Goldfish Bowl.

data.name: Six Steps Ahead
data.description: Swift and silent, the jaracal now runs at your side.
data.spoiler: Tame a Jaracal by using a Skewered Fish on it.

data.name: Skilled Hunter
data.description: You have fully unlocked 10 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
data.spoiler: Unlock all details from 10 hard monsters in your Bestiary.

data.name: Skin-Deep
data.description: You always carry your obsidian knife with you and won't hesitate to use it. You've skinned countless little - and bigger - critters and yeah: they usually don't get any more beautiful on the inside. It's rather blood and gore and all that...
data.spoiler: Successfully skinning 500 monsters.

data.name: Skull and Bones
data.description: Wearing the insignia and dark robes of the Brotherhood of Bones you roam the lands spreading fear and pain, creating new soldiers for the necromantic army which is about to rise soon. Hail the Brotherhood.
data.spoiler: Complete the Brotherhood of Bones Outfit.

data.name: Slayer of Anmothra
data.description: Souls are like butterflies. The black soul of a living weapon yearning to strike lies shattered beneath your feet.
data.spoiler: Do most damage to Anmothra during Rise of Devovorga Quest.

data.name: Slayer of Chikhaton
data.description: Power lies in the will of her who commands it. You fought it with full force - and were stronger.
data.spoiler: Do most damage to Chikhaton during Rise of Devovorga Quest.

data.name: Slayer of Irahsae
data.description: Few things equal the wild fury of a trapped and riven creature. You were a worthy opponent.
data.spoiler: Do most damage to Irahsae during Rise of Devovorga Quest.

data.name: Slayer of Phrodomo
data.description: Blind hatred took physical form, violently rebelling against the injustice it was born into. You were not able to bring justice - but at least temporary peace.
data.spoiler: Do most damage to Phrodomo during Rise of Devovorga Quest.

data.name: Slayer of Teneshpar
data.description: The forbidden knowledge of aeons was never meant to invade this world. You silenced its voice before it could be made heard.
data.spoiler: Do most damage to Teneshpar during Rise of Devovorga Quest.

data.name: Sleepwalking
data.description: You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
data.spoiler: Finish the missions A Cup of Tea, Ancient Dreams and Waters of Life during the Roshamuul Quest.

data.name: Slim Chance
data.description: Okay, let's face it - as long as you believe it could potentially lead you to the biggest treasure ever, you won't let go of that map, however fishy it might look. There must be a secret behind all of this!
data.spoiler: Use a Treasure Map 100 times (Buy it from John at Treasure Island).

data.name: Slimer
data.description: With the assistance of your friendly little helper, you gobbled more than 500 chunks of slime. Well done, Slimer.
data.spoiler: Use Slime Gobbler in Slime Fungus around 500 Times.

data.name: Slugging Around
data.description: Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug. Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
data.spoiler: Tame a Slug.

data.name: Smart Thinking
data.description: Smart you indeed. The gods almost gave up hope that anyone would ever figure THAT one out. They smile on you proudly now.

data.name: Snake Charmer
data.description: By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
data.spoiler: Finish the Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest.

data.name: Snake Pit
data.description: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Marapur in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Snowbunny
data.description: Hopping, hopping through the snow - that's the funnest way to go! Making footprints in a flurry - it's more fun the more you hurry! Licking icicles all day - Winter, never go away!
data.spoiler: Walk over 10,000 snow tiles.

data.name: Some Like It Hot
data.description: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
data.spoiler: Finish the Too Hot to Handle Quest.

data.name: Someone's Bored
data.description: That was NOT a giant spider. There's some witchcraft at work here.
data.spoiler: Kill a fake giant spider.

data.name: Something Smells
data.description: You've exinguished the Sulphur Scuttler's gas clouds and made the air in his cave a little better... at least for a while.
data.spoiler: Slay Sulphur Scutter.

data.name: Something's in There
data.description: By the gods! What was that?
data.spoiler: Step on a hole in a Fallen Tree or Mossy Fallen Tree when eyes appear.

data.name: Soul Crusher
data.description: The Soulpit resonates as the spirit of your final foe shatters under your might.
data.spoiler: Unlock the Animus Mastery for one creature in each bestiary category.

data.name: Soul Mender
data.description: You were burdened with all this soul crushing negativity and still beat Malice, Hatred, Spite, Cruelty and Greed just to help one repentant soul. But as the saying goes: No soul is left behind!
data.spoiler: Complete all Soul War mini bosses while having all 5 Goshnar's Taints active

data.name: Spareribs for Dinner
data.description: Ribstride is striding no more. He had quite a few ribs to spare though.
data.spoiler: Slay Ribstride.

data.name: Spectral Traveller
data.description: You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain several times. The dangers of the nether have become familiar to you and unexperienced travelers turn to you for advice.
data.spoiler: Finish 5 journeys in A Pirate's Death to Me.

data.name: Spectulation
data.description: You checked out a strange temple deep in the jungles of Tiquanda. Spectulus was right, it was indeed overrun by strange fish-men you now call Deathlings.
data.spoiler: Enter the Sunken Temple north-west of Banuta (The Secret Library Quest).

data.name: Spin-Off
data.description: Seems like this spider's got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
data.spoiler: Tame a Wailing Widow.

data.name: Spolium Profundis
data.description: You travelled the depths of this very world. You entered the blackness of the deep sea to conquer the realm of the Deeplings. May this suit remind you of the strange beauty below.
data.spoiler: Complete the Deepling Outfit.

data.name: Spore Hunter
data.description: After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
data.spoiler: Complete the Spore Gathering task of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Stagmeister
data.description: Modifying Brewmaster Bhaan's Raubritter Lager with a hint of Night Harpy, you received a potent remedy against their vicious attacks. Drinking so much of it however, you wonder what other side effects it has as you stare at the moon... mesmerised...
data.spoiler: Drink 20 Bottle of Enhanced Raubritter Lager.

data.name: Stakeholder
data.description: You have spent 70.000.000 gold overall to fund the Great Expedition. Congratulations for helping to make this dream come true!
data.spoiler: Donate 70.000.000 gold overall during the Great Expedition.

data.name: Starless Night
data.description: By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
data.spoiler: Tame a Midnight Panther.

data.name: Steampunked
data.description: Travelling with the dwarven steamboats through the underground rivers is your preferred way of crossing the lands. No pesky seagulls, and good beer on board!
data.spoiler: Travel by Steamship 100 times.

data.name: Steppe Elegance
data.description: Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.
data.spoiler: Get the Antelope mount.

data.name: Stepped on a Big Toe
data.description: This time you knocked out the big one.
data.spoiler: Slay Tromphonyte.

data.name: Stomach Ulcer
data.description: You severely disrupted the digestion of the hive. The hive should for sure see a doctor. It seems you proved to be more than it can swallow.
data.spoiler: Repeat Disrupt The Hives Digestion task 100 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Strangest Thing
data.description: You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours.
data.spoiler: Get the Mutated Abomination mount.

data.name: Stronghold of Edron
data.description: Strong fortresses, sprawling woods and ivory towers - you really know every corner of Edron now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Edron in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Stuntman
data.description: A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
data.spoiler: Tame a Uniwheel.

data.name: Substitute Tinker
data.description: Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
data.spoiler: Complete the Tinker's Bell task of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: Sun and Sea
data.description: You made sure that the balance of sun and sea is preserved in Kilmaresh. The Golden City of Issavi won't forget your favour.
data.spoiler: Finish the Kilmaresh Quest.

data.name: Superstitious
data.description: Fortune tellers and horoscopes guide you through your life. And you probably wouldn't dare going on a big game hunt without your trusty voodoo skull giving you his approval for the day.
data.spoiler: Use 100 Mysterious Voodoo Skull.

data.name: Supplier
data.description: The need for supplies often decides over loss or victory. Your tireless efforts to resupply the resources keeps the war against the hive going.
data.spoiler: Repeat Dissolved Chitin task 50 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Suppressor
data.description: A war is won by those who have the best supply of troops. The hive's troops have been dealt a significant blow by your actions. You interrupted the hive's replenishment of troops lastingly and severely.
data.spoiler: Repeat Pore Stuffing task 100 times in the War Against the Hive Quest.

data.name: Swamp Beast
data.description: By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
data.spoiler: Tame a Water Buffalo.

data.name: Swashbuckler
data.description: Ye be a gentleman o' fortune, fightin' and carousin' on the high seas, out fer booty and lassies! Ye no be answerin' to no man or blasted monarchy and yer life ain't fer the lily-livered. Aye, matey!
data.spoiler: Complete the Pirate Outfit.

data.name: Sweet Tooth
data.description: The famous 'Ode to a Molten Chocolate Cake' was probably written by you. Spending a rainy afternoon in front of the chimney, wrapped in a blanket while indulging in cocoa delights sounds just like something you'd do. Enjoy!
data.spoiler: Bake 10 Chocolate Cakes.

data.name: Swift Death
data.description: Stealth kills and backstabbing are you specialty. Your numerous victims are usually unaware of their imminent death, which you bring to them silently and swiftly. Everything is permitted.
data.spoiler: Complete the Assassin Outfit.

data.name: Talented Dancer
data.description: You're a lord or lady of the dance - and not afraid to use your skills to impress tribal gods. One step to the left, one jump to the right, twist and shout!
data.spoiler: Complete Mission 3 of Unnatural Selection Quest.

data.name: Task Manager
data.description: Helping a poor, stupid goblin to feed his starving children and wifes feels good ... if you'd only get rid of the strange feeling that you're missing something.
data.spoiler: Complete Goblin Merchant Quest tasks 500 times.

data.name: Taskaholic
data.description: You don't just read the bulletin board, you live on it.

data.name: Taskmaster
data.description: Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!
data.spoiler: Complete 500 Expert or Master Weekly Kill Tasks.

data.name: Teamplayer
data.description: You don't consider yourself too good to do the dirty work while someone else might win the laurels for killing Devovorga. They couldn't do it without you!
data.spoiler: Enter one of sub-boss spawns during the Rise of Devovorga Quest.

data.name: Tear the Toxic Veil
data.description: On the shoulders of demons, you tore through veils of venomous corruption. Demonic essences made you an unstoppable force but take care to also foster your human side.
data.spoiler: Deliver 51200 Demonic Core Essences (Rank 10) to Lai in the No Rest For The Wicked quest.

data.name: Territorial
data.description: Your map is your friend - always in your back pocket and covered with countless marks of interesting and useful locations. One could say that you might be lost without it - but luckily there's no way to take it from you.
data.spoiler: Obtainable by asking Guide Alexena (Carlin), Guide Behil (Darashia), Guide Davina (Liberty Bay), Guide Edna (Yalahar), Guide Elena (Venore), Guide Jonathan (Edron), Guide Luke (Thais), Guide Rahlkora (Ankrahmun), Guide Thelandil (Ab'dendriel), and Guide Tiko (Port Hope) to mark your automap.

data.name: The Cake's the Truth
data.description: And anyone claiming otherwise is a liar.
data.spoiler: Bake 30 Cakes.

data.name: The Call of the Wild
data.description: You opposed man-eating ogres and clumsy clomps. You grappled with hungry chieftains, desperate goblins and angry spirits. So you truly overcame the wild vastness of Krailos.
data.spoiler: Complete the 7 missions of the Krailos Quest.

data.name: The Day After
data.description: Uhm... who's that person who you just woke up beside? Broken cocktail glasses on the floor, flowers all over the room, and why the heck are you wearing a ring? Yesterday must have been a long, weird day...
data.spoiler: Obtainable by getting married while being drunk.

data.name: The Drowned Sea God
data.description: As the killer of Leviathan, the giant sea serpent, his underwater kingdom is now under your reign
data.spoiler: Slay Leviathan.

data.name: The Empire's Glory
data.description: Mythical creatures, forgotten catacombs and the Golden City - you really know every corner of Kilmaresh now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Kilmaresh in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: The First of Many
data.description: The first step to greatness has been done.
data.spoiler: Reach the Mastery Weapon Proficiency level on 1 weapon.

data.name: The Forbidden Build
data.description: Surely, this will prove useful in the future... right?
data.spoiler: Reach the Mastery Weapon Proficiency level on any of the following weapons: Club of the Fury, Glooth Blade, Glooth Club, Glutton's Mace, Ice Rapier, Incredible Mumpiz Slayer, Musician's Bow, Poet's Fencing Quill, Pointed Rabbitslayer, Small Stone, Snowball or Stale Bread of Ancientness

data.name: The Gates of Hell
data.description: It seems the gates to the underworld have to remain unprotected for a while. Kerberos, the mighty hellhound, lost his head. All three of them.
data.spoiler: Slay Kerberos.

data.name: The Milkman
data.description: Who's the milkman? You are!
data.spoiler: Complete the daily task of Curos of Delivering Milk.

data.name: The More the Merrier
data.description: It's dangerous to go alone... Take ten friends.
data.spoiler: Used to be obtainable after completing the full Recruiter Outfits.

data.name: The Ogre Steppe
data.description: A vast steppe, voracious ogres and dried out salt seas - you really know every corner of Krailos now.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Krailos in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: The Picky Pig
data.description: The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable?
data.spoiler: Complete the Mushroom Digger task of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest.

data.name: The Professor's Nut
data.description: He seriously stored away a wallnut? That was a nutty professor indeed.
data.spoiler: Open the chest after completing the Hero of Rathleton Quest.

data.name: The Right Tone
data.description: By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
data.spoiler: Tame a Crystal Wolf.

data.name: The Rootwalker
data.description: Traversing the innards of Podzilla was a conquest in and by itself, thanks to Two Lips you are now one with the plant biosphere as you stride its many intertwined trails.
data.spoiler: Get the full Rootwalker Outfit.

data.name: The Rule of Raccool
data.description: You almost feel as cool as a raccoon. Now, where's the trash?
data.spoiler: Get the full Draccoon Herald Outfit.

data.name: The Serpent's Bride
data.description: You made a knot with Gorgo's living curls and took her scalp. You couldn't save her countless petrified victims, but at least you didn't become one.
data.spoiler: Slay Gorgo.

data.name: The Snowman
data.description: You love the winter. Fully equipped with scarf and gloves, you like to have fun outside while building lots of snowmen with your friends. Snowball fight, anyone?
data.spoiler: Open a Snowman Package 100 times. After a patch, now you can use the same package to get the achievement.

data.name: The Spirit of Purity
data.description: Withstanding both filth and desolation of the rotten darkness that corrupted the very core of this world, you embodied the weapon of purity and light to defy all that was tainted. This spirit will continue guide you on all future paths.
data.spoiler: Taming a Spirit of Purity.

data.name: The Undertaker
data.description: You and your shovel - a match made in heaven. Or hell, for that matter. Somewhere down below in any case. You're magically attracted by stone piles and love to open them up and see where those holes lead you. Good biceps as well.
data.spoiler: Open 500 Loose Stone Piles or Large Holes.

data.name: Thick-Skinned
data.description: It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
data.spoiler: Obtain a Stampor from Chondur.

data.name: Tied the Knot
data.description: You figured out the right order of spells in the buried cathedral, how enchanting!
data.spoiler: Find all spell words during the Haunted House mission in The Dream Courts Quest.

data.name: Toothfairy Assistant
data.description: You assisted a very prominent fae and you fought tooth and nail to earn this title.
data.spoiler: Finish the Tooth Fairy part of the Threatened Dreams Quest and then deliver all the teeth requested by the same NPC.

data.name: Top AVIN Agent
data.description: You've proven yourself as a worthy member of the 'family' and successfully carried out numerous spy missions for your 'uncle' to support the Venorean traders and their goals.
data.spoiler: Finish the Secret Service Quest for the AVIN faction

data.name: Top CGB Agent
data.description: Girl power! Whether you're female or not, you've proven absolute loyalty and the willingness to put your life at stake for the girls brigade of Carlin.
data.spoiler: Finish the Secret Service Quest for the CGB faction.

data.name: Top TBI Agent
data.description: Conspiracies and open secrets are your daily bread. You've shown loyalty to the Thaian crown through your courage when facing enemies and completing spy missions. You're an excellent field agent of the TBI.
data.spoiler: Finish the Secret Service Quest for the TBI faction.

data.name: Torn Treasures
data.description: Wyda seems to be really, really bored. You also found out that she doesn't really need all those blood herbs that adventurers brought her. Still, she was nice enough to take one from you and gave you something quite cool in exchange.
data.spoiler: Give a random amount of Blood Herbs to Wyda until you get a Torn Teddy during the Bored Mini World Change.

data.name: Traditionalist
data.description: You proudly wear the traditional Orcsoberfest garb, same as it ever was and as it always will be.
data.spoiler: Get the full Orcsoberfest Garb Outfit by participating in 6 different editions of Orcsoberfest.

data.name: Trail of the Ape God
data.description: You've discovered a trail of giant footprints and Terrified Elephants running everywhere. Could it be that the mysterious ape god is rambling in the jungle?
data.spoiler: Kill 5 Terrified Elephants during the Stampede Mini World Change.

data.name: Transmutator
data.description: You, Sir or Lady, are a true alchemist. Conducting transmutating experiments to find every possible combination has been your secret passion since years and the results of your research are incredible. Science has just taken a leap thanks to you!
data.spoiler: Transmute into 22 different creatures on the Alchemist Quarter's Transmutator.

data.name: Treasure Hunter
data.description: You wandered the world of Tibia in search of the ancient dragons' hoards. You are sure, you found them all.
data.spoiler: Open all 20 Dragon Chests during the First Dragon Quest.

data.name: Trip to the Beach
data.description: Braving a hive full of unimaginable proportions and its grotesque creatures on the surface is only one side of Gray Beach. Your full trip of the island also included a dive into the black nothingness of the deep sea, facing the wrath of the Njey.
data.spoiler: Fully discover Gray Beach in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: True Colours
data.description: You and your friends showed the three wizards your loyalty three times - I am sure at least one of them is probably eternally thankful and exceedingly proud of you.
data.spoiler: Participate in the The Colours of Magic event three times (colors don't matter).

data.name: True Dedication
data.description: You conquered the demon challenge and prevailed... now show off your success in style!
data.spoiler: Complete the Demon Outfit.

data.name: True Lightbearer
data.description: You're one of the most dedicated Lightbearers - without you, the demons would have torn the veil between the worlds for sure. You've lit each and every basin, travelling high and low, pushing back the otherworldly forces. Let there be light!
data.spoiler: Light every basin in the Lightbearer event.

data.name: Truth Be Told
data.description: You told Jack the truth by explaining you and Spectulus made a mistake when trying to convince him of being a completely different person.
data.spoiler: Tell the truth to Jack after finishing Jack to the Future Quest.

data.name: Turncoat
data.description: You served Yalahar - but you didn't seem so sure whom to believe on the way. Both Azerus and Palimuth had good reasons for their actions, and thus you followed your gut instinct in the end, even if you helped either of them. May Yalahar prosper!
data.spoiler: Complete mission 9 of In Service of Yalahar Quest and following some of Yalahari's and some of Palimuth's instructions.

data.name: Twisted Dreams
data.description: A journey through a dreamscape of evil is no small feat. Yet you traversed the nightmarish lands of Roshamuul and live to tell the tale. Don't fall asleep now...
data.spoiler: Fully discover Roshamuul in your Cyclopedia Map.

data.name: Twisted Mutation
data.description: You've slain Esmeralda, the most hideous and aggressive of the mutated rats. No one will know that you almost lost a finger in the process.
data.spoiler: Slay Esmeralda.

data.name: Umbral Archer
data.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
data.spoiler: Create an Umbral Master Bow.

data.name: Umbral Berserker
data.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
data.spoiler: Create an Umbral Master Hammer.

data.name: Umbral Bladelord
data.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
data.spoiler: Create an Umbral Master Slayer.

data.name: Umbral Brawler
data.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
data.spoiler: Create an Umbral Master Mace.

data.name: Umbral Executioner
data.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
data.spoiler: Create an Umbral Master Chopper.

data.name: Umbral Harbinger
data.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
data.spoiler: Create an Umbral Master Spellbook.

data.name: Umbral Headsman
data.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
data.spoiler: Create an Umbral Master Axe.

data.name: Umbral Marksman
data.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
data.spoiler: Create an Umbral Master Crossbow.

data.name: Umbral Master
data.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
data.spoiler: Create all of the Master Umbral Weapons.

data.name: Umbral Redeemer
data.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your katar into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
data.spoiler: Create an Umbral Master Katar.

data.name: Umbral Swordsman
data.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
data.spoiler: Create an Umbral Masterblade.

data.name: Unleash the Beast
data.description: You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.
data.spoiler: Get the full Revenant Outfit.

data.name: Unlikely Pathfinder
data.description: Wow - what was that? You don't know how you ended up here, but somehow you did. How to get from Beregar to Kazordoon in a jiffy - that's something those dwarves would love to know, but you're not quite sure how to reproduce it.
data.spoiler: Travel from Beregar to Kazordoon through the Wagon Maze.

data.name: Up the Molehill
data.description: Putting this candle stump on your new mount was kind of a waiting game. You're even tempted to call it whack-a-mole. But in the end you found a loyal companion for your journeys into the depths.
data.spoiler: Tame a Mole.

data.name: Vanity
data.description: Aren't you just perfectly, wonderfully, beautifully gorgeous? You can't pass a mirror without admiring your looks. Or maybe doing a quick check whether something's stuck in your teeth, perhaps?
data.spoiler: Use Wall Mirrors 300 times.

data.name: Verminbane
data.description: And so it begins!
data.spoiler: Complete 100 Beginner Weekly Kill Tasks.

data.name: Vive la Resistance
data.description: You've always been a rebel - admit it! Supplying prisoners, caring for outcasts, stealing from the rich and giving to the poor - no wait, that was another story.
data.spoiler: Finish the Daily Task of Children of the Revolution Quest.

data.name: Vortex Tamer
data.description: After a long journey and dedication you were favoured by fortune and have tamed all three elusive beasts of the vortex. Unless the Vortexion decides you're a tasty morsel you can enjoy your small stable of ravaging beasts from beyond.
data.spoiler: Tame a Neon Sparkid, a Sparkion, and a Vortexion.

data.name: Wail of the Banshee
data.description: You saw the Crystal Gardens with all their stunning beauty and survived the equally impressive monsters there. In the end you discovered a great evil and destroyed it with the help of a banshee who was not even aware of her support.
data.spoiler: Complete The Cursed Crystal Quest.

data.name: Warlock
data.description: You're proficient in the darker ways of magic and are usually found sitting inside a circle of candles and skulls muttering unspeakable words. Don't carry things too far or the demons might come get you.
data.spoiler: Complete the Wizard Outfit.

data.name: Warlord of Svargrond
data.description: You sent the Obliverator into oblivion in the arena of Svargrond and defeated nine other dangerous enemies on the way. All hail the Warlord of Svargrond!
data.spoiler: Finish the Barbarian Arena Quest in the Warlord difficulty.

data.name: Warrior of the Iks
data.description: Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.
data.spoiler: Get the full Ancient Aucar Outfit.

data.name: Waverider
data.description: One thing's for sure: You definitely love swimming. Hanging out on the beach with your friends, having ice cream and playing beach ball is splashingly good fun!
data.spoiler: Swim 100,000 tiles.

data.name: Way of the Shaman
data.description: Shaking your rattle and dancing around the fire to jungle drums sounds like something you like doing. Besides, dreadlocks are a convenient way to wear your hair - no combing required!
data.spoiler: Complete the Shaman Outfit.

data.name: Way to Hell
data.description: This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
data.spoiler: Tame a Magma Crawler.

data.name: Wayfarer
data.description: Dragon dreams are golden.
data.spoiler: Complete mission 9 of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest.

data.name: Wedding Planner
data.description: Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
data.spoiler: Complete the Star-Crossed Lovers mission in the Within the Tides Quest.

data.name: Well Roared, Lion!
data.description: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
data.spoiler: Tame a White Lion

data.name: Whistle-Blower
data.description: You can't keep a secret, can you? Then again, you're just fulfilling your duty to the Queen of Carlin as a lawful citizen. That's a good thing, isn't it...?
data.spoiler: Tell Queen Eloise about Chip during Lumberjack Mini World Change.

data.name: Widely Travelled
data.description: As a true globetrotter you can now show your colours proudly with this extraordinary outfit.
data.spoiler: Unlock the Discoverer Outfit.

data.name: Wild Warrior
data.description: Valour is for weaklings - it doesn't matter how you win the battle, as long as you're victorious. Thick armor would just hinder your movements, thus you keep it light and rely on speed and skill instead of hiding in an uncomfortable shell.
data.spoiler: Complete the Warrior Outfit.

data.name: Witches Lil' Helper
data.description: You sacrificed ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches.
data.spoiler: Throw one ingredient into the witches cauldron during the Bewitched event.

data.name: With a Cherry on Top
data.description: You like your cake soft, with fruity bits and a nice sugar icing. And you prefer to make them by yourself. Have you ever considered opening a bakery? You must be really good by now!
data.spoiler: Decorate 20 Cakes with fruits.

data.name: Woodcarver
data.description: You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
data.spoiler: Defeat Megasylvan Yselda in the Adventures of Galthen Quest.

data.name: Workhorse
data.description: Whether it's clearing cellars from rats or delivering quara eyes with a smile, you get the job done.
data.spoiler: Complete 500 Weekly Tasks.

data.name: Worm Whacker
data.description: Weehee! Whack those worms! You sure know how to handle a big hammer.
data.spoiler: Complete mission 4 of the Isle of Evil Quest.

data.name: Yalahari of Power
data.description: You defend Yalahar with brute force and are ready to lead it into a glorious battle, if necessary. Thanks to you, Yalahar will be powerful enough to stand up against any enemy.
data.spoiler: Get the evil side addon of the Yalaharian Outfit.

data.name: Yalahari of Wisdom
data.description: Your deeds for Yalahar are usually characterised by deep insight and thoughtful actions. Thanks to you, Yalahar might have a chance to grow peacefully and with happy people living in it.
data.spoiler: Get the good side addon of the Yalaharian Outfit.

data.name: You Don't Know Jack
data.description: You did not tell Jack the truth about the mistake you and Spectulus made when trying to convince him about being a completely different person. He will live in doubt until the end of his existence.
data.spoiler: Lie to Jack after finishing Jack to the Future Quest.

data.name: You got Horse Power
data.description: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
data.spoiler: Get the Phantasmal Jade mount.

data.name: Zzztill Zzztanding!
data.description: You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain
data.spoiler: Slay Fazzrah.
